````
1: # Surfaces and actions
2: 
3: Read `docs/ui/surfaces.md` before this implementation reference. Read
4: `docs/ui/collections.md` when the surface has filters, tabs, tables, or card
5: collections.
6: 
7: ## Surface map
8: 
9: | Need | Use |
10: |---|---|
11: | Standard list | `ListView v-bind="resource.list()"` |
12: | Standard detail | `DetailView v-bind="resource.detail({ id })"` |
13: | Standard create or update | `FormView` with the matching action prop bag |
14: | Custom collection | `Table` or `ListView #collection`; `Table` keeps collection states |
15: | Custom record | `Detail` |
16: | Custom form | `Form` or `DialogForm` |
17: | Tree | `TreeTable` |
18: | List query controls | `ListView #filters` with `Form` or `ChipFilter` |
19: | Dialog, confirmation, button, card, feedback | Existing framework composite or base component |
20: 
21: ## Standard resource path
22: 
23: Follow [action placement](../../../../DESIGN.md#actions-and-forms).
24: 
25: Resource actions are independent. Expose the actions required by the task;
26: a resource does not need all CRUD actions. Select the form surface from the
27: design rules for the required navigation and retained context.
28: Preserve existing route access unless it changes within the user request.
29: 
30: Use the module schema, one field catalog, and the app Hono adapter:
31: 
32: ```ts
33: const api = createHonoResourceActions(rpc.items)
34: const fields = defineFields(itemsSchema, {
35:   name: { label: 'Name', form: { renderer: 'text' } },
36: })
37: 
38: export const items = defineResource(itemsSchema, {
39:   key: 'items',
40:   actions: {
41:     list: { run: api.list, fields: [fields.name], permission: 'view-items', route: { name: 'items' } },
42:     detail: { run: api.detail, fields: [fields.name], permission: 'view-items', route: { name: 'items-detail', params: (id) => ({ itemId: String(id) }) } },
43:     create: { run: api.create, fields: [fields.name], permission: 'create-items', route: { name: 'items-create' } },
44:     update: { run: api.update, fields: [fields.name], permission: 'update-items', route: { name: 'items-edit', params: (id) => ({ itemId: String(id) }) } },
45:     delete: { run: api.delete, permission: 'delete-items' },
46:   },
47: })
48: ```
49: 
50: Use a generated route name that exists in `apps/web/route-map.d.ts`. Do not
51: pass `dataAdapter` to `createHonoResourceActions`; it already owns response
52: normalization.
53: 
54: Select field references in the visible order for each action. Omission removes
55: a field from that surface. Use one terminal `.override(...)` for one local
56: field difference.
57: 
58: ## Custom resource actions
59: 
60: Declare custom actions in `actions` with exactly `run` and `permission`.
61: Use a nonempty permission string, a nonempty array of these strings requiring
62: every permission, or `null` for no client permission check. A synchronous
63: resolver takes the same arguments as `run` and returns one of these values.
64: Use `resource.actions.name.can(...args)` for UI access checks; `run(...args)`
65: checks permission again before the callback. Keep server authorization.
66: `resource.permissions` and `resourceCan` cover standard actions only.
67: Standard `run` calls do not gain this custom-action guard.
68: 
69: ## Action prop bags
70: 
71: Pass standard actions directly:
72: 
73: ```vue
74: <ListView v-bind="items.list()" />
75: <DetailView v-bind="items.detail({ id })" />
76: <FormView v-bind="items.create()" />
77: <DialogForm :key="record.id" v-bind="items.update({ id: record.id })" title="Edit item">
78:   <template #trigger>
79:     <Button>Edit</Button>
80:   </template>
81: </DialogForm>
82: ```
83: 
84: `Form` and `DialogForm` accept a structural `{ run }` action bag. Do not add a
85: wrapper such as `dialogFormOf`, and do not compose raw `Dialog` + `Form` when
86: `DialogForm` fits. Render one keyed `DialogForm` per record action. Let it own
87: ordinary visibility and completion. Read [the forms guide](../../../../docs/ui/forms.md#dialog-forms)
88: before an advanced caller controls visibility with `v-model:open`.
89: 
90: ## Collection variants and action overrides
91: 
92: Use `ListView #collection` to show a card or grid view of the same loaded
93: collection. It keeps one `Collection` through `Table`, so do not start another
94: loader or rebuild query/cache state. The slot supplies records and standard
95: `actions`; use those actions instead of rebuilding route or permission logic.
96: The framework renders loading, error, and empty states before it invokes the
97: custom collection slot.
98: 
99: For a custom standard control in `ListView`, use:
100: 
101: - `#create-action` only to replace the standard Create action
102: - `#resource-action` for Import, Export, Download, and other resource actions
103: - `#row-actions-view`
104: - `#row-actions-edit`
105: - `#row-actions-delete`
106: 
107: The Create and resource-action slots share one right-aligned action row, with
108: Create first. A resource action does not replace Create. The framework owns
109: whether a standard-action override can render. The route owns how its control
110: looks and runs. Do not add a second permission `v-if` around override content.
111: A server record capability without a declared standard action or override does
112: not create a control.
113: 
114: Do not feed `ListView` a synthetic `run` that returns a local ref. Declare a
115: real scoped list action so collection caching, loading, errors, and query state
116: stay intact.
117: 
118: ## Custom surfaces
119: 
120: For a tree or other surface outside standard Views:
121: 
122: - Use `resourceCan(resource)` from `apps/web/src/framework/access.ts` for
123:   standard actions; use [custom action checks](#custom-resource-actions) for custom actions.
124: - Use `errorMessage(error, fallback)` from the app normalization adapter.
125: 
126: Keep server-derived record actions or `allowedOperations` as the record-level
127: authority. API authorization still runs on submit. Each delete action declares its
128: permission or explicit `null`; each destructive control confirms the action.
129: 
130: ## Filters and tabs
131: 
132: `ListView` uses the `filters` prop for its Filter button and popover. The
133: `#filters` slot renders a separate section; it does not enable that button.
134: Choose the supported surface before writing the browser interaction.
135: 
136: Follow `docs/ui/collections.md`. Keep query state route-local. Use
137: `ChipFilter` for a collection query and state its optional or required
138: selection contract. Use framework `Tabs` for one selected local surface or
139: presentation. Use the app routing Tabs component for route navigation.
140: 
141: ## Collection content
142: 
143: Select collection content from [DESIGN.md](../../../../DESIGN.md#page-structure).
144: 
145: Custom collections preserve the standard query and result contract. Trace paging
146: from the control through the request, server limit/order/count, and normalized
147: response. Use an unpaged collection only for a defined bounded set or an explicit
148: product requirement; a small seed dataset does not establish a bound.
149: 
150: Keep search, filters, sorting, and paging in the collection query. Preserve
151: unrelated query keys when one filter changes and reset the page to one. A
152: local presentation switch preserves that query. Use the existing namespaced
153: URL adapter so sibling lists do not collide and shared links restore state;
154: query refinements normally replace the current URL. For a nested list, include its
155: parent in source parameters and cache identity; the server enforces the scope.
````

```
import type { CollectionLoadContext, CollectionResult } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { parseHonoResponse } from '@/framework/hono'
import { rpc } from '@/framework/rpc'
import type { RolePermission } from './role-permissions.schema'

type ListEndpoint = (typeof rpc.roles)[':roleId']['permissions']['$get']

function positiveInt(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {
  const parsed = Number(value)
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback
}

async function list({ query, searchParameters, signal }: CollectionLoadContext): Promise<CollectionResult<RolePermission>> {
  const roleId = String(searchParameters.role_id ?? '')
  if (!roleId) return { data: [] }
  const wireQuery = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(query)
      .filter(([, value]) => value != null && value !== '')
      .map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value)])
  )
  const payload = await parseHonoResponse<ListEndpoint>(await rpc.roles[':roleId'].permissions.$get({ param: { roleId }, query: wireQuery }, { init: { signal } }))
  const data = payload.data as RolePermission[]
  const envelope = payload as unknown as Record<string, unknown>
  const params = query as Record<string, unknown>
  const total = typeof envelope.total === 'number' ? envelope.total : data.length
  const page = positiveInt(envelope.page ?? params.page, 1)
  const pageSize = positiveInt(envelope.limit ?? envelope.pageSize ?? params.limit, 10)
  const totalPage = typeof envelope.totalPage === 'number' ? envelope.totalPage : Math.ceil(total / pageSize)
  return { data, meta: { total, page, pageSize, totalPage } }
}

async function set(roleId: string, permissionId: string, assigned: boolean): Promise<RolePermission> {
  const route = rpc.roles[':roleId'].permissions[':permissionId']
  const request = { param: { roleId, permissionId } }
  if (assigned) return (await parseHonoResponse<typeof route.$put>(await route.$put(request))).data as RolePermission
  return (await parseHonoResponse<typeof route.$delete>(await route.$delete(request))).data as RolePermission
}

export const rolePermissionsActions = { list, set }

import { defineRoute, notFound } from '@southneuhof/sprindle'
import { and, asc, count, desc, eq, ilike, or, sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { getDb } from '../../../../../db'
import { requirePermission } from '../../../../../identity'
import { permissions } from '../../../permissions/permissions.entity'
import { rolePermissions, roles } from '../../roles.entity'

const querySchema = z.object({
  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1),
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(10),
  search: z.string().trim().optional(),
  sort_by: z.enum(['permissionCode', 'name', 'description', 'assigned']).default('permissionCode'),
  sort: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).default('asc'),
})

export const GET = defineRoute({ authorize: requirePermission('list-role-permissions'), action: async (args) => {
  const query = querySchema.parse(args.c.req.query())
  const role = (await getDb().select({ id: roles.id }).from(roles).where(eq(roles.id, args.params.roleId)).limit(1))[0]
  if (!role) throw notFound()
  const search = query.search ? `%${query.search}%` : undefined
  const where = and(eq(permissions.active, true), search ? or(
    ilike(permissions.permissionCode, search),
    ilike(permissions.name, search),
    ilike(permissions.description, search),
  ) : undefined)
  const sortColumn = query.sort_by === 'assigned'
    ? sql`coalesce(${rolePermissions.active}, false)`
    : permissions[query.sort_by]
  const rows = await getDb()
    .select({
      id: permissions.id,
      permissionCode: permissions.permissionCode,
      name: permissions.name,
      description: permissions.description,
      assigned: rolePermissions.active,
    })
    .from(permissions)
    .leftJoin(rolePermissions, and(
      eq(rolePermissions.permissionId, permissions.id),
      eq(rolePermissions.roleId, args.params.roleId),
    ))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(query.sort === 'desc' ? desc(sortColumn) : asc(sortColumn), asc(permissions.id))
    .limit(query.limit)
    .offset((query.page - 1) * query.limit)
  const [total] = await getDb().select({ value: count() }).from(permissions).where(where)
  const data = rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, assigned: row.assigned === true }))
  return { data, total: total!.value }
} })
```

```
import { defineRoute, HttpError, notFound } from '@southneuhof/sprindle'
import { and, eq } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { getDb } from '../../../../../../db'
import { requireOrgIdentity, requirePermission } from '../../../../../../identity'
import { permissions } from '../../../../permissions/permissions.entity'
import { rolePermissions, roles } from '../../../roles.entity'

function now() {
  return new Date().toISOString()
}

async function rolePermissionState(roleId: string, permissionId: string) {
  const row = (await getDb()
    .select({
      id: permissions.id,
      permissionCode: permissions.permissionCode,
      name: permissions.name,
      description: permissions.description,
      assigned: rolePermissions.active,
    })
    .from(permissions)
    .leftJoin(rolePermissions, and(
      eq(rolePermissions.permissionId, permissions.id),
      eq(rolePermissions.roleId, roleId),
    ))
    .where(eq(permissions.id, permissionId))
    .limit(1))[0]
  if (!row) throw notFound()
  return { ...row, assigned: row.assigned === true }
}

async function setRolePermission(actorUserId: string, roleId: string, permissionId: string, active: boolean) {
  await getDb().transaction(async (tx) => {
    const foundRole = (await tx.select().from(roles).where(eq(roles.id, roleId)).limit(1))[0]
    const foundPermission = (await tx.select().from(permissions).where(eq(permissions.id, permissionId)).limit(1))[0]
    if (!foundRole || !foundPermission) throw notFound()
    if (active && !foundPermission.active) throw new HttpError(422, 'permission_inactive')
    const existing = (await tx.select().from(rolePermissions).where(and(
      eq(rolePermissions.roleId, roleId),
      eq(rolePermissions.permissionId, permissionId),
    )).limit(1))[0]
    if (existing?.active === active || (!existing && !active)) return
    if (existing) {
      await tx.update(rolePermissions).set({ active, updatedAt: now(), updatedByUserId: actorUserId }).where(and(
        eq(rolePermissions.roleId, roleId),
        eq(rolePermissions.permissionId, permissionId),
      ))
    } else {
      await tx.insert(rolePermissions).values({ roleId, permissionId, active, createdByUserId: actorUserId, updatedByUserId: actorUserId })
    }
  })
  return rolePermissionState(roleId, permissionId)
}

const change = (active: boolean) => async (args: Parameters<Parameters<typeof defineRoute>[0]['action']>[0]) => ({
  data: await setRolePermission((await requireOrgIdentity(args)).userId, args.params.roleId, args.params.permissionId, active),
})

export const PUT = defineRoute({ authorize: requirePermission('create-role-permissions'), action: change(true) })
export const DELETE = defineRoute({ authorize: requirePermission('delete-role-permissions'), action: change(false) })

import type { InferRequestType, InferResponseType } from 'hono/client'
import type { StatusCode } from 'hono/utils/http-status'
import type { CollectionLoadContext, CollectionResult, RecordIdentity, WebResourceSchema } from '@southneuhof/loom'

export type HonoRequestOf<TEndpoint> = InferRequestType<TEndpoint>
export type HonoResponseOf<TEndpoint, TStatus extends StatusCode> = InferResponseType<TEndpoint, TStatus>

type EndpointAt<TRoute, TKey extends string, TMethod extends string> = TKey extends keyof TRoute
  ? TRoute[TKey] extends infer TNode
    ? TMethod extends keyof TNode
      ? TNode[TMethod]
      : never
    : never
  : never
type DetailEndpoint<TRoute, TMethod extends string> = 'detail' extends keyof TRoute
  ? TRoute['detail'] extends infer TDetail
    ? ':id' extends keyof TDetail
      ? TDetail[':id'] extends infer TNode
        ? TMethod extends keyof TNode
          ? TNode[TMethod]
          : never
        : never
      : never
    : never
  : never
type ListEndpoint<TRoute> = EndpointAt<TRoute, 'list', '$get'>
type DetailGetEndpoint<TRoute> = DetailEndpoint<TRoute, '$get'>
type CreateEndpoint<TRoute> = EndpointAt<TRoute, 'create', '$post'>
type UpdateEndpoint<TRoute> = 'update' extends keyof TRoute
  ? TRoute['update'] extends infer TUpdate
    ? ':id' extends keyof TUpdate
      ? TUpdate[':id'] extends infer TNode
        ? '$patch' extends keyof TNode
          ? TNode['$patch']
          : never
        : never
      : never
    : never
  : never
type DeleteEndpoint<TRoute> = 'delete' extends keyof TRoute
  ? TRoute['delete'] extends infer TDelete
    ? ':id' extends keyof TDelete
      ? TDelete[':id'] extends infer TNode
        ? '$delete' extends keyof TNode
          ? TNode['$delete']
          : never
        : never
      : never
    : never
  : never
type DataOf<T> = T extends { data: infer TValue } ? TValue : never
type ListRecordOf<T> = DataOf<T> extends readonly (infer TValue)[] ? TValue : never
type JsonOf<TEndpoint> = HonoRequestOf<TEndpoint> extends { json: infer TValue } ? TValue : Record<string, never>
type QueryOfEndpoint<TEndpoint> = HonoRequestOf<TEndpoint> extends { query: infer TValue } ? TValue : Record<string, never>
type ObjectJsonOf<TEndpoint> = JsonOf<TEndpoint> extends object ? JsonOf<TEndpoint> : Record<string, never>
type IsExactlyUnknown<TValue> = unknown extends TValue ? ([keyof TValue] extends [never] ? true : false) : false
type UnknownKeys<TPayload extends object> = {
  [TKey in keyof TPayload]-?: IsExactlyUnknown<TPayload[TKey]> extends true ? TKey : never
}[keyof TPayload]
type AdaptedObject<TPayload extends object> = Omit<TPayload, UnknownKeys<TPayload>> & Partial<Pick<TPayload, UnknownKeys<TPayload>>>
type UnionKeys<TPayload> = TPayload extends unknown ? keyof TPayload : never
type UnionValue<TPayload, TKey extends PropertyKey> = TPayload extends unknown ? (TKey extends keyof TPayload ? TPayload[TKey] : never) : never
type RequiredUnionKeys<TPayload> = {
  [TKey in UnionKeys<TPayload>]: [TPayload] extends [Record<TKey, unknown>] ? TKey : never
}[UnionKeys<TPayload>]
type UnionObject<TPayload extends object> =
  string extends UnionKeys<TPayload>
    ? TPayload
    : { [TKey in RequiredUnionKeys<TPayload>]: UnionValue<TPayload, TKey> } & { [TKey in Exclude<UnionKeys<TPayload>, RequiredUnionKeys<TPayload>>]?: UnionValue<TPayload, TKey> }
type AdaptedUnionObject<TPayload> = TPayload extends object ? (TPayload extends readonly unknown[] ? TPayload : AdaptedObject<TPayload>) : never
type AdapterPayload<TPayload> = [TPayload] extends [object] ? ([TPayload] extends [readonly unknown[]] ? TPayload : UnionObject<AdaptedUnionObject<TPayload>>) : TPayload
type KnownKeys<T> = { [TKey in keyof T]-?: string extends TKey ? never : TKey }[keyof T]
type QueryValue<TWire, TKey extends PropertyKey, TFallback> = TKey extends keyof TWire ? TWire[TKey] : TFallback
type AdapterQuery<TWire extends object> = {
  page?: QueryValue<TWire, 'page', string> | number
  limit?: QueryValue<TWire, 'limit', string> | number
  search?: QueryValue<TWire, 'search', string>
  sort?: QueryValue<TWire, 'sort', string>
  order?: QueryValue<TWire, 'order', string>
} & {
  [TKey in Exclude<KnownKeys<TWire>, 'page' | 'limit' | 'search' | 'sort' | 'order'>]?: TWire[TKey]
}

export type HonoRecordOf<TRoute> = [ListEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
  ? DataOf<HonoResponseOf<DetailGetEndpoint<TRoute>, 200>> extends object
    ? DataOf<HonoResponseOf<DetailGetEndpoint<TRoute>, 200>>
    : Record<string, unknown>
  : ListRecordOf<HonoResponseOf<ListEndpoint<TRoute>, 200>> extends object
    ? ListRecordOf<HonoResponseOf<ListEndpoint<TRoute>, 200>>
    : Record<string, unknown>
export type HonoQueryOf<TRoute> = [ListEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never] ? Record<string, never> : AdapterQuery<QueryOfEndpoint<ListEndpoint<TRoute>> & object>
export type HonoCreateOf<TRoute> = AdapterPayload<ObjectJsonOf<CreateEndpoint<TRoute>>>
export type HonoUpdateOf<TRoute> = AdapterPayload<ObjectJsonOf<UpdateEndpoint<TRoute>>>

export type AppResourceContract<TRoute, TRecord extends object = HonoRecordOf<TRoute>> = WebResourceSchema<TRecord, HonoQueryOf<TRoute>, HonoCreateOf<TRoute>, HonoUpdateOf<TRoute>, RecordIdentity>

type MutationRecordOf<TEndpoint, TStatus extends StatusCode> = DataOf<HonoResponseOf<TEndpoint, TStatus>> extends object ? DataOf<HonoResponseOf<TEndpoint, TStatus>> : Record<string, unknown>

export type HonoResourceActions<TRoute> = ([ListEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
  ? {}
  : {
      list: (context: CollectionLoadContext<HonoQueryOf<TRoute>>) => Promise<CollectionResult<HonoRecordOf<TRoute>>>
    }) &
  ([DetailGetEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
    ? {}
    : {
        detail: (context: { id?: RecordIdentity; searchParameters: Record<string, unknown>; signal?: AbortSignal }) => Promise<HonoRecordOf<TRoute> | undefined>
      }) &
  ([CreateEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
    ? {}
    : {
        create: (input: HonoCreateOf<TRoute>) => Promise<MutationRecordOf<CreateEndpoint<TRoute>, 201>>
      }) &
  ([UpdateEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
    ? {}
    : {
        update: (id: RecordIdentity, input: HonoUpdateOf<TRoute>) => Promise<MutationRecordOf<UpdateEndpoint<TRoute>, 200>>
      }) &
  ([DeleteEndpoint<TRoute>] extends [never]
    ? {}
```

```
import { and, eq, getTableColumns, isNull } from 'drizzle-orm'
import type { AnyColumn, InferSelectModel, SQL } from 'drizzle-orm'
import type { PgTable } from 'drizzle-orm/pg-core'
import { HttpError, notFound } from '../errors'
import { getPrimaryKeyEntries } from './drizzle-internals'

/** The slice of the Drizzle transaction handle `lockRow` needs. `never` parameters keep the shape assignable from Drizzle's generic builders. */
type LockDb = {
  select: (fields?: unknown) => {
    from: (table: never) => {
      where: (condition: never) => {
        for: (mode: 'update') => Promise<unknown[]>
      }
    }
  }
}

export type LockRowOptions = {
  /** Every key must equal the locked row's value; a miss answers 409 invalid_transition. */
  require?: Record<string, unknown>
  /** Replaces the default 409 message. */
  failMessage?: string
}

function parseCompositeId(id: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (id && typeof id === 'object' && !Array.isArray(id)) return id as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof id === 'string') {
    const value = JSON.parse(id)
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) return value
  }
  throw new Error('Composite primary key id must be an object or JSON object string')
}

/**
 * Lock-and-guard read for transactional transitions: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE by
 * primary key with a liveness predicate (`deletedAt IS NULL` when the table
 * has that column). An absent row answers `notFound()`; a `require` guard
 * miss answers 409 `invalid_transition`. The caller owns the transaction.
 */
export async function lockRow<T extends PgTable>(
  db: LockDb,
  table: T,
  id: string,
  options: LockRowOptions = {},
): Promise<InferSelectModel<T>> {
  const primaryKey = getPrimaryKeyEntries(table)
  const values = primaryKey.length === 1 ? { [primaryKey[0].key]: id } : parseCompositeId(id)
  const identity: SQL[] = primaryKey.map(({ key, column }) => eq(column, values[key]))

  const columns = getTableColumns(table as never) as Record<string, AnyColumn>
  const liveness: SQL[] = columns.deletedAt ? [isNull(columns.deletedAt)] : []

  const rows = await db.select().from(table as never).where(and(...identity, ...liveness) as never).for('update')
  const row = rows[0] as InferSelectModel<T> | undefined
  if (!row) throw notFound()

  if (options.require) {
    for (const [key, expected] of Object.entries(options.require)) {
      if ((row as Record<string, unknown>)[key] !== expected) {
        throw new HttpError(409, 'invalid_transition', options.failMessage ?? 'The record is not in the required state.')
      }
    }
  }
  return row
}
```

```
1: # Coffeeshop POS
2: 
3: ## Result and scope
4: 
5: - User result: Staff manage menu categories and menu items, take counter sale orders, and record cash, transfer, or QRIS payment with change.
6: - Included: Menu category CRUD. Menu item CRUD with category relation, price, and availability flag. Order list, detail, and create with line items. Pay order custom action. Cancel order custom action. POS sell page. Navigation entries. Permissions and seed for new permissions.
7: - Excluded: Item variants, sizes, and options. Stock counts. Table numbers. Dine-in and takeaway types. Discounts, tax, and fees. Receipt printing. Shifts, reports, and analytics. Browser and E2E checks.
8: - Requirement source: User request 2026-09-19 to create a POS for a small coffeeshop with drinks, snacks, and foods. User answers 2026-09-19: menu category plus menu plus orders plus payment; counter sale with no order types; cash plus transfer and QRIS; availability toggle only.
9: - Design approval: APPROVED. User reply "LGTM. Approved" 2026-09-19. Revision 2026-09-19. Scope: full design as written.
10: - Process selection: Standard module path. Reason: CRUD plus two bounded custom actions. Rules and results can be specified and checked locally. No approval chain. No cross-module derived state beyond order totals.
11: 
12: ## Data and access
13: 
14: - Records and fields:
15:   - `menu_category`: `id` text key, `name` text required and unique, `active` boolean default true, audit fields, timestamps. Meaning: menu group such as drinks, snacks, foods.
16:   - `menu_item`: `id` text key, `name` text required, `categoryId` text required, `price` integer IDR required and not negative, `active` boolean default true (available or sold out), `description` nullable text, audit fields, timestamps. Meaning: one sellable menu entry.
17:   - `order`: `id` text key, `status` enum `open`, `paid`, `cancelled`, default `open`, `paymentMethod` enum `cash`, `transfer`, `qris`, null until paid, `total` integer IDR stored snapshot, `amountPaid` integer IDR null until paid, `change` integer IDR stored snapshot, audit fields, timestamps. Meaning: one counter sale.
18:   - `order_item`: child row with no independent screens. `id` text key, `orderId` FK, `menuItemId` FK, `name` text snapshot, `unitPrice` integer IDR snapshot, `qty` integer 1 to 99, `lineTotal` integer snapshot. Meaning: one ordered menu line.
19: - Relations: One category has many items. Stored identity is `menu_item.categoryId`. Selectable label is category `name`. Displayed value is category `name`. Edit value loads the same `categoryId`. One order has many order items. Stored identity is `order_item.orderId`. One order item refers to one menu item. Stored identity is `order_item.menuItemId`. Displayed value is snapshot `name`. List, detail, and returned writes include category `name` on items and item snapshots on orders.
20: - Access: Authenticated staff only. New permissions use standard verbs. Proposed codes: `view-menu-categories`, `list-menu-categories`, `detail-menu-categories`, `create-menu-categories`, `update-menu-categories`, `delete-menu-categories`; same six verbs for `menu-items`; for `orders`: `view-orders`, `list-orders`, `detail-orders`, `create-orders`, `pay-orders`, `cancel-orders`. No `update-orders` and no `delete-orders`. Server enforces each action. Navigation shows an entry only with its `view-*` permission. Assumption, not confirmation: admin role gets all new permissions through seed. Existing roles keep current access until an admin grants new permissions.
21: - Constraints:
22:   - `menu_category.name` is unique. `menu_item.price` is an integer IDR and is not negative. `menu_item.active` false means sold out and hidden from the sell page.
23:   - An order has one or more lines. Each `qty` is 1 to 99. Assumption: upper bound 99 prevents input error.
24:   - At create time each item must exist and have `active` true. The write stores `name` and `unitPrice` snapshots. `lineTotal` is `unitPrice` times `qty`. `total` is the sum of lines.
25:   - Pay requires status `open`, a `paymentMethod`, and `amountPaid` not less than `total`. `change` is `amountPaid` minus `total`. Sell page defaults `amountPaid` to `total` for transfer and QRIS. Assumption: overpay is allowed for all methods and shows as change.
26:   - Cancel requires status `open`. It keeps lines for history. It stores no payment data.
27:   - `paid` and `cancelled` orders are final. No edit, no delete, no second pay, no second cancel. Invalid transitions return 409 `invalid_transition`.
28:   - Delete guard: no delete of a category with items. No delete of a menu item used in any order line. Normal removal is `active` false. Database FK uses restrict for these links and cascade from order to its lines.
29: - Standard CRUD pattern: Existing roles module. API entity plus `+scope.ts` plus `list`, `detail`, `create`, `update`, `delete` `+server.ts` files. Web schema plus resource plus `ListView`, `DetailView`, `FormView` routes.
30: 
31: ## Custom behavior
32: 
33: ### Pay order
34: 
35: - Trigger and inputs: Detail controls area on paid-eligible open order, and Sell page after create. Inputs: `paymentMethod` (`cash`, `transfer`, `qris`), `amountPaid` integer IDR.
36: - Conditions: Caller has `pay-orders`. Order status is `open`.
37: - Successful result: Status becomes `paid`. Stores `paymentMethod`, `amountPaid`, `change`, and payment audit stamp. Order detail shows paid chip, method label, amount paid, and change. Orders list refreshes.
38: - Stored effects: One atomic write of order payment fields. No change to menu data. No change to order lines.
39: - Failure behavior: Missing or inaccessible order returns 404. Wrong status or `amountPaid` below `total` returns 409 or field error and stores nothing. Form keeps draft and shows error. No duplicate submit.
40: - Control states: Pending blocks repeat pay for that order. Success shows confirmation. Failure restores prior state and reports stale data on refresh failure without a second write.
41: 
42: ### Cancel order
43: 
44: - Trigger and inputs: Detail controls area on open order. No inputs. Confirm dialog names the order and states that lines stay for history.
45: - Conditions: Caller has `cancel-orders`. Order status is `open`.
46: - Successful result: Status becomes `cancelled`. Detail shows cancelled chip. List refreshes.
47: - Stored effects: One atomic write of status plus audit stamp. Lines unchanged.
48: - Failure behavior: Missing or inaccessible order returns 404. Wrong status returns 409 and stores nothing.
49: - Control states: Pending blocks repeat cancel. Success shows confirmation. Failure shows error.
50: 
51: ### Sell page order flow
52: 
53: - Trigger and inputs: `pos/sell` page. Item list shows only `active` categories and `active` items. Cart lines hold `menuItemId` and `qty`. Payment block holds `paymentMethod` and `amountPaid`. Change preview is `amountPaid` minus cart total when valid.
54: - Conditions: Caller has `create-orders` and `pay-orders` for immediate pay. Items stay active at submit time.
55: - Successful result: Standard create makes an `open` order with snapshots and total. Then pay action records payment. Page shows order number and change, then clears cart. Failed pay leaves a visible `open` order in Orders for retry.
56: - Stored effects: Same as create plus pay. Two writes in order. No combined endpoint.
57: - Failure behavior: Empty cart, inactive item, bad `qty`, or bad payment input is rejected with field errors. First write failure stores nothing. Second write failure keeps the `open` order and reports it.
58: - Control states: Submit pending blocks duplicate submit. Cart edits stay local until submit.
59:

65: | Order create snapshots prices and totals | API test with two lines | Stored `name`, `unitPrice`, `lineTotal`, and `total` match menu values at write time; later menu price change does not alter the order |
66: | Inactive item cannot be ordered | API test with `active` false item | Create rejected; nothing stored |
67: | Pay moves open to paid with correct change | API test for cash overpay and QRIS exact pay | Stored `paymentMethod`, `amountPaid`, `change`, and `paid` status correct; second pay rejected with 409 and stored row unchanged |
68: | Cancel moves open to cancelled and keeps lines | API test for cancel then pay | Cancelled order keeps lines; later pay rejected with 409 |
69: | Delete guards protect history | API test for category with items and item with order lines | Delete rejected; rows unchanged; deactivation with `active` false still works |
70: | Access control denies unauthorized writes | API test without `create-orders` and `pay-orders` | 401 or 403; stored data unchanged |
71: | Pages, navigation, and permissions connect | Source review plus type-check and lint | Sell, Orders, Menu Items, and Menu Categories routes exist; POS navigation requires `view-*`; resource actions carry permissions; type-check and lint pass |

74: - Unresolved decisions: None. Inferred defaults above are part of this approval request.
75: - Browser and E2E checks: excluded.
```

````
1: # Sprindle reference
2: 
3: Sprindle uses Hono, Drizzle, Zod, and file routes. The route directory is the
4: only source of HTTP locations.
5: 
6: ## File routes
7: 
8: A `+server.ts` file exports `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, or
9: `OPTIONS`. Each export uses `defineRoute`, `list`, `detail`, `create`, `update`,
10: or `deleteRoute` from `@southneuhof/sprindle`. `defineRoute` takes `action` and
11: has no method or path option.
12: 
13: ```ts
14: // src/routes/health/+server.ts
15: import { defineRoute } from '@southneuhof/sprindle'
16: 
17: export const GET = defineRoute({ action: () => ({ ok: true }) })
18: ```
19: 
20: Normal directory names add URL segments. `(group)` names do not add a segment.
21: `[id]` adds `:id`. Static names can contain dots. `detail({})`, `update({})`,
22: and `deleteRoute({})` use `id`. Use `param: 'userId'` for another declared
23: parameter.
24: 
25: The nearest `+scope.ts` can supply `context`, `entity`, `enrich`, `identity`,
26: and pipeline hooks. Context fields from a child replace fields with the same
27: name from a parent. The runtime creates context for each request. It resolves
28: identity at most once. A parent authorization failure stops child context work.
29: 
30: ```ts
31: // src/routes/(authenticated)/products/+scope.ts
32: import { authenticated, defineScope } from '@southneuhof/sprindle'
33: import { product } from '../../products/products.entity'
34: 
35: export default defineScope({ entity: product, authorize: authenticated() })
36: ```
37: 
38: Canonical resource operations use the entity in the nearest scope. Their wire
39: contracts are:
40: 
41: | Helper | Method | Success |
42: |---|---|---|
43: | `list` | GET | 200 `{ data, page, limit, total }` |
44: | `detail` | GET | 200 `{ data }` or 404 |
45: | `create` | POST | 201 `{ data }` |
46: | `update` | PATCH | 200 `{ data }` or 404 |
47: | `deleteRoute` | DELETE | 200 `{ ok: true }` or 404 |
48: 
49: `run` changes persistence while the helper keeps parsing, status, enrichment,
50: and the response envelope. Scope enrichment converts a source record to its
51: public record first. Route enrichment receives that public record.
52: 
53: The operation order is scope context and authorization, route authorization,
54: state parsing, server write values, `before`, `validate`, action, and operation
55: `after`. Errors unwind through only the scopes that were entered. Hono
56: middleware owns headers, logging, cleanup, and other work for all responses.
57: 
58: GET supplies HEAD when no HEAD export exists. An explicit HEAD export takes
59: priority. Unsupported methods return 405 with `Allow`. Missing paths return 404.
60: 
61: ## Domains and sources
62: 
63: `createEntity` joins a table to create, update, and select Zod schemas.
64: `defineDomainPart` groups tables and entities. Applications pass ordinary
65: domain parts to `defineDomainSchema` and `bindDomainDatabase`. Domain ownership
66: does not depend on route files.
67: 
68: `ModelSource` supplies `list`, `detail`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, and
69: `materialize`. The Drizzle source keeps relation writes and the result read in
70: one transaction. Canonical hooks can set `state.where` for server read or write
71: scope and `state.values` for server-owned create or update values.
72: 
73: ## Build, OpenAPI, and client types
74: 
75: The hidden route tooling reads the directory once and builds one executable
76: manifest before server startup. Production loads that artifact and does not
77: scan source or load the compiler. The same directory model supplies batch and
78: editor types, OpenAPI paths, and the private SDK contract. A developer uses the
79: normal project commands and does not run a generator or import a generated file.
80: 
81: Use `generateOpenApi(manifest, info)` or `generateInstalledOpenApi(info)`.
82: Custom JSON routes can set `openapi.requestBody` to their Zod input schema.
83: 
84: ## Errors and request context
85: 
86: `validationError`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, and `notFound` produce the
87: standard `{ error, message?, issues? }` envelope. Unknown errors return
88: `internal_error` and are logged. `requestContext()` assigns and returns an
89: `x-request-id`.
````

```
12: function initialRoleIds(roleIds: string[]) {
13:   const uniqueRoleIds = [...new Set(roleIds)]
14:   if (!uniqueRoleIds.length || uniqueRoleIds.length !== roleIds.length) throw new HttpError(422, 'roles_required')
15:   return uniqueRoleIds
16: }
17: 
18: async function validateInitialRoles(roleIds: string[]) {
19:   const uniqueRoleIds = initialRoleIds(roleIds)
20:   const foundRoles = await getDb().select({ id: roles.id, active: roles.active }).from(roles).where(inArray(roles.id, uniqueRoleIds))
21:   if (foundRoles.length !== uniqueRoleIds.length || foundRoles.some((row) => !row.active)) throw new HttpError(422, 'roles_required')
22:   return uniqueRoleIds
23: }
24: 
25: async function assignInitialRoles(actorUserId: string, userId: string, roleIds: string[]) {
26:   const uniqueRoleIds = initialRoleIds(roleIds)
27:   await getDb().transaction(async (tx) => {
28:     const foundRoles = await tx.select({ id: roles.id, active: roles.active }).from(roles).where(inArray(roles.id, uniqueRoleIds))
29:     if (foundRoles.length !== uniqueRoleIds.length || foundRoles.some((row) => !row.active)) throw new HttpError(422, 'roles_required')
30:     await tx.insert(roleAssignments).values(uniqueRoleIds.map((roleId) => ({
31:       userId,
32:       roleId,
33:       active: true,
34:       createdByUserId: actorUserId,
35:       updatedByUserId: actorUserId,
36:     })))
37:   })
38: }

40: export const POST = defineRoute({
41:   openapi: { requestBody: createUserSchema },
42:   authorize: requirePermission('create-users'),
43:   action: async (args) => {
44:     const input = createUserSchema.parse(await readJsonBody(args.c))
45:     const identity = await orgIdentity(args)
46:     if (!identity) throw unauthorized()
47:     const existing = await getDb().select({ id: users.id }).from(users).where(eq(users.email, input.email)).limit(1)
48:     if (existing[0]) return args.c.json({ error: 'email_exists' }, 409)
49: 
50:     let userId: string | undefined

52:       await validateInitialRoles(input.roleIds)
53:       const result = await createAuth({ allowSignUp: true }).api.signUpEmail({
54:         body: { name: input.name, email: input.email, password: input.password },
55:       })
56:       userId = result.user?.id
57:       if (!userId) return args.c.json({ error: 'user_create_failed' }, 422)
58:       const updated = await getDb().select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, userId)).limit(1)
59:       await assignInitialRoles(identity.userId, userId, input.roleIds)
60:       const createdUser = user.schemas.select.parse(updated[0] ?? result.user)
61:       return created(args.c, publicRecord(user.schemas.select, createdUser))
62:     } catch (error) {

64:       if (isHttpError(error)) return args.c.json({ error: error.code, ...(error.message ? { message: error.message } : {}) }, error.status as 400)
65:       return args.c.json({ error: 'user_create_failed' }, 409)
66:     }
67:   },
```

```
95: export function defineDomainSchema(parts: readonly DomainPart[]): DomainSchema {
96:   const schema: Record<string, unknown> = {}
97:   const relations: Record<string, RelationConfig> = {}
98:   const entities: DomainEntity[] = []
99:   const relationsByTable = new Map<unknown, Record<string, unknown>>()
100:   const relationFieldsByEntity = new Map<DomainEntity, string[]>()
101:   const relationMetadataByEntity = new Map<DomainEntity, DomainRelationField[]>()
102:   const writeRelationMetadataByEntity = new Map<DomainEntity, DomainRelationField[]>()
103:   const tableKeyByEntity = new Map<DomainEntity, string>()
104:   const entityByTable = new Map<unknown, DomainEntity>()
105:   const entityBySelectSchema = new Map<unknown, DomainEntity>()
106: 
107:   for (const part of parts) {
108:     Object.assign(schema, part.tables)
109:     entities.push(...part.entities)
110:     for (const relationMap of part.relations ?? []) {
111:       for (const [relationKey, config] of Object.entries(relationMap)) {
112:         const previous = relations[relationKey]
113:         relations[relationKey] = previous ? { ...config, relations: { ...previous.relations, ...config.relations } } : config
114:       }
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   for (const entity of entities) {
119:     entityByTable.set(entity.table, entity)
120:     entityBySelectSchema.set(entity.schemas.select, entity)
121:     const tableKey = Object.entries(schema).find(([, table]) => table === entity.table)?.[0]
122:     if (!tableKey) throw new Error(`Missing Drizzle table declaration for entity "${entity.name}".`)
123:     tableKeyByEntity.set(entity, tableKey)
124:   }
125: 
126:   for (const relation of Object.values(relations)) {
127:     relationsByTable.set(relation.table, relation.relations)
128:   }
129: 
130:   for (const entity of entities) {
131:     const { readRelations, writeRelations } = validateEntityRelations({ entity, relationsByTable, entityBySelectSchema, entityByTable })
132:     relationFieldsByEntity.set(
133:       entity,
134:       readRelations.map((relation) => relation.field),
135:     )
136:     relationMetadataByEntity.set(entity, readRelations)
137:     writeRelationMetadataByEntity.set(entity, writeRelations)
138:   }
139: 
140:   return { schema, relations, entities, relationsByTable, relationFieldsByEntity, relationMetadataByEntity, writeRelationMetadataByEntity, tableKeyByEntity }
141: }

143: export function bindDomainDatabase(domainSchema: DomainSchema, db: unknown) {
144:   for (const entity of domainSchema.entities) {
145:     entity.source = createDrizzleSource({
146:       db,
147:       table: entity.table,
148:       schemas: entity.schemas,
149:       domainSchema,
150:       entity,
151:       read: entity.read,
152:     })
153:     markSourceBound(entity.source)
154:   }
155: }
156: 
157: function validateEntityRelations({
158:   entity,
159:   relationsByTable,
160:   entityBySelectSchema,
161:   entityByTable,
162: }: {
163:   entity: DomainEntity
164:   relationsByTable: Map<unknown, Record<string, unknown>>
165:   entityBySelectSchema: Map<unknown, DomainEntity>
166:   entityByTable: Map<unknown, DomainEntity>
167: }) {
168:   const readRelations: DomainRelationField[] = []
169:   const columns = getTableColumns(entity.table as never) as Record<string, unknown>
170:   const relations = relationsByTable.get(entity.table) ?? {}
171:   const aliases = new Map(
172:     Object.entries(relations)
173:       .map(([key, relation]) => [(relation as { alias?: string }).alias, key] as const)
174:       .filter(([alias]) => alias),
175:   )
176: 
177:   for (const [field, schema] of Object.entries(getZodShape(entity.schemas.select))) {
178:     if (field in columns) continue
179: 
180:     const aliasFor = aliases.get(field)
181:     if (aliasFor) throw new Error(`Invalid relation field "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\n"${field}" is a Drizzle alias. Use the relation key "${aliasFor}" in schemas.select.`)
182: 
183:     const nested = getNestedEntitySchema(schema, entityBySelectSchema)
184:     if (!nested) {
185:       throw new Error(`Unknown nested object field "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nNested relation fields must use another entity's schemas.select.`)
186:     }
187: 
188:     const relation = relations[field]
189:     if (!relation) throw new Error(`Missing Drizzle relation for select field "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\nAdd a relation named "${field}" in defineRelationsPart().`)
190: 
191:     if (nested.isArray && !is(relation, Many)) {
192:       throw new Error(`Cardinality mismatch for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nDrizzle relation "${field}" is one, but schemas.select.${field} is an array.`)
193:     }
194:     if (!nested.isArray && !is(relation, One)) {
195:       throw new Error(`Cardinality mismatch for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nDrizzle relation "${field}" is many, but schemas.select.${field} is not an array.`)
196:     }
197:     const targetTable = (relation as { targetTable?: unknown }).targetTable
198:     if (targetTable !== nested.entity.table) {
199:       throw new Error(`Target entity mismatch for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nDrizzle relation "${field}" targets table "${getTableName(targetTable as never)}".\nschemas.select.${field} uses entity "${nested.entity.name}".`)
200:     }
201: 
202:     readRelations.push(createRelationField({ field, relation, targetEntity: nested.entity, isArray: nested.isArray, entityName: entity.name }))
203:   }
204: 
205:   const writeRelations = new Map(readRelations.map((relation) => [relation.field, relation]))
206:   for (const relation of [
207:     ...validateWriteSchema({ entity, schemaName: 'create', columns, relations, entityByTable }),
208:     ...validateWriteSchema({ entity, schemaName: 'update', columns, relations, entityByTable }),
209:   ]) {
210:     writeRelations.set(relation.field, relation)
211:   }
212: 
213:   return { readRelations, writeRelations: [...writeRelations.values()] }
214: }
215: 
216: function validateWriteSchema({
217:   entity,
218:   schemaName,
219:   columns,
220:   relations,
221:   entityByTable,
222: }: {
223:   entity: DomainEntity
224:   schemaName: 'create' | 'update'
225:   columns: Record<string, unknown>
226:   relations: Record<string, unknown>
227:   entityByTable: Map<unknown, DomainEntity>
228: }) {
229:   const relationFields: DomainRelationField[] = []
230:   for (const [field, schema] of Object.entries(getZodShape(entity.schemas[schemaName]))) {
231:     if (field in columns) continue
232: 
233:     const relation = relations[field]
234:     if (!relation) throw new Error(`Unknown ${schemaName} field "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nNested write fields must match a Drizzle relation.`)
235: 
236:     const isArray = isZodArray(unwrapZod(schema))
237:     if (isArray && !is(relation, Many)) {
238:       throw new Error(`Cardinality mismatch for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nDrizzle relation "${field}" is one, but schemas.${schemaName}.${field} is an array.`)
239:     }
240:     if (!isArray && !is(relation, One)) {
241:       throw new Error(`Cardinality mismatch for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".\n\nDrizzle relation "${field}" is many, but schemas.${schemaName}.${field} is not an array.`)
242:     }
243: 
244:     const targetTable = (relation as { targetTable?: unknown }).targetTable
245:     const targetEntity = entityByTable.get(targetTable)
246:     if (!targetEntity) throw new Error(`Target entity missing for relation "${field}" on entity "${entity.name}".`)
247: 
248:     relationFields.push(createRelationField({ field, relation, targetEntity, isArray, entityName: entity.name }))
249:   }
250:   return relationFields
251: }
252: 
253: function createRelationField({
254:   field,
255:   relation,
256:   targetEntity,
257:   isArray,
258:   entityName,
259: }: {
260:   field: string
261:   relation: unknown
262:   targetEntity: DomainEntity
263:   isArray: boolean
264:   entityName: string
265: }): DomainRelationField {
266:   const throughTable = (relation as { throughTable?: unknown }).throughTable
267:   const through = (relation as { through?: { source: unknown[]; target: unknown[] } }).through
268:   return {
269:     field,
270:     targetEntity,
271:     isArray,
272:     mode: throughTable ? 'through' : 'direct',
273:     sourceColumns: getRelationColumns(relation, 'sourceColumns', field, entityName),
274:     targetColumns: getRelationColumns(relation, 'targetColumns', field, entityName),
275:     ...(throughTable
276:       ? {
277:           throughTable,
278:           throughSourceColumns: getThroughColumns(through?.source, field, entityName),
279:           throughTargetColumns: getThroughColumns(through?.target, field, entityName),
280:         }
281:       : {}),
282:   }
283: }
284: 
285: function getRelationColumns(relation: unknown, key: 'sourceColumns' | 'targetColumns', field: string, entityName: string): AnyColumn[] {
286:   const columns = (relation as { [K in typeof key]?: AnyColumn[] })[key]
287:   if (!columns?.length) throw new Error(`Missing ${key} for relation "${field}" on entity "${entityName}".`)
288:   return columns
289: }
290: 
291: function getThroughColumns(columns: unknown[] | undefined, field: string, entityName: string): AnyColumn[] {
292:   if (!columns?.length) throw new Error(`Missing through columns for relation "${field}" on entity "${entityName}".`)
293:   const resolved = columns.map((column) => resolveThroughColumn(column))
294:   if (resolved.some((column) => !column)) throw new Error(`Invalid through columns for relation "${field}" on entity "${entityName}".`)
295:   return resolved as AnyColumn[]
296: }
297: 
298: function getNestedEntitySchema(schema: unknown, entityBySelectSchema: Map<unknown, DomainEntity>) {
299:   const unwrapped = unwrapZod(schema)
300:   if (isZodArray(unwrapped)) {
301:     const entity = entityBySelectSchema.get(unwrapZod(getZodArrayElement(unwrapped)))
302:     return entity ? { entity, isArray: true } : undefined
303:   }
304:   const entity = entityBySelectSchema.get(unwrapped)
305:   return entity ? { entity, isArray: false } : undefined
306: }
307: 
308: function unwrapZod(schema: unknown): unknown {
309:   while (
310:     getZodDef(schema)?.type === 'optional' ||
311:     getZodDef(schema)?.type === 'nullable' ||
312:     getZodDef(schema)?.type === 'lazy' ||
313:     getZodDef(schema)?.typeName === 'ZodOptional' ||
314:     getZodDef(schema)?.typeName === 'ZodNullable' ||
315:     getZodDef(schema)?.typeName === 'ZodLazy'
316:   ) {
317:     schema = (schema as { unwrap?: () => unknown }).unwrap?.() ?? (getZodDef(schema)?.getter as (() => unknown) | undefined)?.() ?? getZodDef(schema)?.innerType
318:   }
319:   return schema
320: }
321: 
322: function getZodShape(schema: AnySchema): Record<string, unknown> {
323:   const shape = (schema as { shape?: unknown }).shape ?? getZodDef(schema)?.shape
324:   const value = typeof shape === 'function' ? shape() : shape
325:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') throw new Error('schemas.select must be a Zod object.')
326:   return value as Record<string, unknown>
327: }
328: 
329: function isZodArray(schema: unknown) {
330:   const def = getZodDef(schema)
331:   return def?.type === 'array' || def?.typeName === 'ZodArray'
332: }
333: 
334: function getZodArrayElement(schema: unknown) {
335:   const def = getZodDef(schema)
336:   return def?.element ?? def?.type
337: }
338: 
339: function getZodDef(schema: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
340:   return ((schema as { _def?: unknown; def?: unknown })?._def ?? (schema as { def?: unknown })?.def) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
341: }
342: 
343: function unboundSource(): ModelSource {
344:   const fail = async () => {
345:     throw new Error('Domain database is not bound. Call bindDomainDatabase() before model routes run.')
346:   }
347:   return { list: fail, detail: fail, create: fail, update: fail, delete: fail, materialize: fail }
348: }
```

```
8: because a database query returned them.
9: 
10: Use scope `enrich: { schema, run }` for conversion shared by list/detail/create/
11: update. The schema validates the public record. Its callback runs once per list
12: row: keep it free of database and remote I/O. Use list `enrich` to fetch derived
13: data for all returned IDs, then join by ID with a `Map` or `Set`. Return early
14: for an empty list. Query only the extra data, not the base row again.
15: 
16: Route enrichment runs after scope enrichment. Preserve the declared public shape
17: when adding operation-specific fields. Keep detail/create/update display data
18: consistent so a saved form can render immediately. A custom route must apply its
19: own public schema; scope enrichment does not run for `defineRoute`.
20: 
21: Use focused context endpoints only when a form needs a bounded set of dependent
22: choices or derived defaults that normal resource reads cannot supply. Scope
23: those choices by the caller and current selection. Large choice sets remain
24: searchable and paginated; do not return an entire business hierarchy by default.
25: 
26: ## Selection values
27: 
28: `selectionValues(exactItemSchema)` in `src/schema.ts` is the multi-selection
29: contract. Its items are objects with the exact keys the field uses; `id` and
30: `name` are not universal. Use `selectionQuery` for the corresponding JSON query
31: value. Coordinate with `$build-resource-form` when changing these fields.
32: 
33: Resolve submitted identity keys on the server, validate membership and allowed
34: state, and read current labels from storage. A client-supplied display label is
35: not authoritative. Reject duplicate choices where the relation is a set. Return
36: the same public object-array shape after a write.
37: 
38: ## Stored files
39: 
40: Reuse `storedAssetSchema`, `storedAssetInput`, and `uploadKey` from
41: `src/schema.ts`, and the current conversion functions in `src/storage/assets.ts`.
42: External URLs need a separate explicit schema. Do not persist temporary signed
43: download URLs.
44: 
45: For standard and custom file writes, follow the shared
46: [asset-object contract](../../carta-module-development/references/frontend-field-contract.md#asset-fields).
47: Use `z.input` for the HTTP shape and `z.output` for parsed persistence values.
48: 
49: Use `storedAssetModel(publicSchema)` for canonical records and
50: `publicRecord(publicSchema, value)` for a custom result when these fit. Convert
51: at the public-record boundary; do not add response-wide JSON parsing or custom
52: field wrappers to turn keys into URLs.
53: 
54: File access needs the product's permission and ownership rules. A valid key
55: format or authenticated session alone does not prove access to that object.
56: Check download, attach, replace, and delete paths against the record's policy.
57: Validate allowed content type and size at the upload boundary. Client-declared
58: metadata alone cannot prove the uploaded bytes meet those limits; enforce the
59: required limit in storage or verify the stored object before accepting it.
60: 
61: Reuse `src/storage/s3.ts` for object operations. Coordinate database references
62: and object removal so a failed transaction cannot remove a still-used file.
63: Do not delete a shared object when one record stops referencing it. Add orphan
64: cleanup only when upload cancellation or retention requirements need it.
```

```
168:   const materializeOne = async (row: unknown, reader: DrizzleDb = database): Promise<TRecord> => {
169:     if (!tableKey || !withRelations) return schemas.select.parse(row)
170:     const id = getRowId(row, primaryKey)
171:     const hydrated = await reader.query?.[tableKey]?.findFirst({ where: wherePrimaryKeyObject(id), with: withRelations })
172:     if (!hydrated) throw new Error(`Record not found while materializing table "${tableKey}".`)
173:     return schemas.select.parse(hydrated)
174:   }
175: 
176:   return {
177:     async list({ query, where: scopeWhere }) {
178:       const requested = normalizeListQuery(query ?? {})
179:       const relational = relationalReader(database)
180:       const presentVirtuals: { param: CreateDrizzleSourceVirtualParam; value: unknown }[] = []
181:       for (const [field, param] of Object.entries(virtualParams)) {
182:         const raw = requested[field]
183:         if (raw === undefined) continue
184:         presentVirtuals.push({ param, value: param.validate ? param.validate(raw, field) : requireStringParam(raw, field) })
185:       }
186: 
187:       // Drizzle's relational reader aliases its root table as d0. Build a
188:       // virtual condition against that same alias so awaited builders remain
189:       // valid in both the count query and the relational query.
190:       const planAlias = relational && presentVirtuals.length ? RELATIONAL_ROOT_ALIAS : undefined
191:       const planTable = planAlias ? aliasedTable(table as never, planAlias) : table
192:       const planColumns = getTableColumns(planTable as never) as Record<string, AnyColumn>
193:       const virtualConditions = await Promise.all(presentVirtuals.map(({ param, value }) => param.where(value, planColumns)))
194:       const plan = buildListPlan(requested, planColumns, planAlias, virtualConditions)
195:       // Server-owned read scope: ANDed after the plan, so nothing in the query
196:       // can unset it. A scope is either a SQL predicate or a
197:       // `(table, operators) => SQL` factory. Factories serve relational reads,
198:       // which alias their base table: the source invokes the factory against
199:       // the real table for counting/builder reads and hands the factory itself
200:       // to the relational query as a RAW filter, so Drizzle binds it to the
201:       // aliased row.
202:       const scopeFactory = typeof scopeWhere === 'function' ? (scopeWhere as unknown as (table: unknown, op: typeof operators) => unknown) : undefined
203:       const scopeSql = scopeFactory ? scopeFactory(planTable, operators) : scopeWhere
204:       const where = and(plan.where as never, scopeSql as never)
205:       const total = await countRows(where, planTable)
206: 
207:       if (relational) {
208:         const objectWhere = scopeWhere
209:           ? plan.objectWhere
210:             ? { AND: [plan.objectWhere, { RAW: scopeWhere }] }
211:             : { RAW: scopeWhere }
212:           : plan.objectWhere
213:         const rows = await relational.findMany({ where: objectWhere, orderBy: plan.relationalOrderBy, limit: plan.limit, offset: plan.offset, with: withRelations })
214:         return { data: rows.map((row) => schemas.select.parse(row)), total }
215:       }
216: 
217:       let builder = selectRows()
218:       if (where) builder = builder.where(where)
219:       if (plan.orderByColumns) builder = builder.orderBy(...plan.orderByColumns)
220:       const rows = await builder.limit(plan.limit).offset(plan.offset)
221:       return { data: rows.map((row) => schemas.select.parse(row)), total }
222:     },
223:     async detail({ id, where: scopeWhere }) {
224:       // Server-owned read scope on single-row reads, mirroring `list`: the
225:       // scope is ANDed after the primary-key predicate, and a scope factory
226:       // binds to the aliased base table for relational reads.
227:       const scopeFactory = typeof scopeWhere === 'function' ? (scopeWhere as unknown as (table: unknown, op: typeof operators) => unknown) : undefined
228:       const scopeSql = scopeFactory ? scopeFactory(table, operators) : scopeWhere
229:       const relational = relationalReader(database)
230:       if (relational) {
231:         const where = scopeWhere ? { AND: [wherePrimaryKeyObject(id), { RAW: scopeWhere }] } : wherePrimaryKeyObject(id)
232:         const hydrated = await relational.findFirst({ where, with: withRelations })
233:         return hydrated ? schemas.select.parse(hydrated) : null
234:       }
235:       const rows = await selectRows().where(and(wherePrimaryKey(id), scopeSql as never)).limit(1)
236:       return rows[0] ? schemas.select.parse(rows[0]) : null
237:     },
238:     async create({ input, inputParsed, values = {} }) {
239:       const parsed = inputParsed ? input as TCreate : schemas.create.parse(input)
240:       const { row, relations } = splitRelationInput({ ...parsed, ...values }, relationByField)
241:       applyOneRelationValues(row, relations, tableColumns)
242:       return withTransaction(database, async (tx) => {
243:         const rows = await tx.insert(table).values(row).returning()
244:         if (rows[0]) {
245:           const id = getReturnedId(rows[0], primaryKey)
246:           await applyManyRelationValues(tx, id, relations, primaryKey, tableColumns)
247:           return (await materialize(rows[0], tx)) as TRecord
248:         }
249:         return schemas.select.parse(rows[0])
250:       })
251:     },
252:     async update({ id, input, inputParsed, values = {}, where: scopeWhere }) {
253:       const parsed = inputParsed ? input as TUpdate : schemas.update.parse(input)
254:       const { row, relations } = splitRelationInput({ ...parsed, ...values }, relationByField)
255:       applyOneRelationValues(row, relations, tableColumns)
256:       return withTransaction(database, async (tx) => {
257:         const where = and(wherePrimaryKey(id), resolveWriteScope(scopeWhere) as never)
258:         const rows = hasKeys(row)
259:           ? await tx.update(table).set(row).where(where).returning()
260:           : await tx.select().from(table).where(where).limit(1)
261:         if (rows[0]) {
262:           await applyManyRelationValues(tx, id, relations, primaryKey, tableColumns)
263:           return (await materialize(rows[0], tx)) as TRecord
264:         }
265:         return rows[0] ? schemas.select.parse(rows[0]) : null
266:       })
267:     },
268:     async delete({ id, where: scopeWhere }) {
269:       const rows = await database.delete(table).where(and(wherePrimaryKey(id), resolveWriteScope(scopeWhere) as never)).returning()
270:       return Boolean(rows[0])
271:     },
272:     async materialize(input) {
273:       return materialize(input)
274:     },
275:   }
276: }

278: const RESERVED_LIST_QUERY_KEYS = new Set(['page', 'limit', 'search', 'sort', 'order'])
279: const DEFAULT_LIST_LIMIT = 20
280: const RELATIONAL_ROOT_ALIAS = 'd0'
281: 
282: type ListOrdering = {
283:   search: string | undefined
284:   pinnedOrder: CreateDrizzleSourceRead['pinnedOrder']
285:   order: 'asc' | 'desc'
286:   sort: string | undefined
287: }
288: 
289: function resolveListOrdering(
290:   query: Record<string, unknown>,
291:   columns: Record<string, AnyColumn>,
292:   virtualKeys: Set<string>,
293:   pinnedOrder: CreateDrizzleSourceRead['pinnedOrder'],
294: ): ListOrdering {
295:   const search = virtualKeys.has('search') ? undefined : typeof query.search === 'string' && query.search.length ? query.search : undefined
296:   const order = query.order === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
297:   const sort = pinnedOrder || query.sort == null || query.sort === '' ? undefined : String(query.sort)
298:   if (sort && !(sort in columns)) throw validationError(`Unknown sort column "${sort}".`)
299:   return { search, pinnedOrder, order, sort }
300: }
301: 
302: function collectListFilters(query: Record<string, unknown>, columns: Record<string, AnyColumn>, virtualKeys: Set<string>) {
303:   const filters: { key: string; value: unknown }[] = []
304:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
305:     if (RESERVED_LIST_QUERY_KEYS.has(key) || virtualKeys.has(key) || value === undefined) continue
306:     if (!(key in columns)) throw validationError(`Unknown query parameter "${key}".`)
307:     filters.push({ key, value: coerceFilterValue(key, columns[key], value) })
308:   }
309:   return filters
310: }
311: 
312: function buildListConditions(filters: { key: string; value: unknown }[], search: string | undefined, searchColumnKeys: string[], virtualConditions: SQL[], columns: Record<string, AnyColumn>) {
313:   const hasSearch = Boolean(search && searchColumnKeys.length)
314:   const searchCondition = hasSearch ? or(...searchColumnKeys.map((key) => ilike(columns[key], `%${search}%`))) : undefined
315:   const searchObject = hasSearch ? { OR: searchColumnKeys.map((key) => ({ [key]: { ilike: `%${search}%` } })) } : undefined
316:   return {
317:     conditions: [
318:       ...filters.map(({ key, value }) => eq(columns[key], value)),
319:       ...(searchCondition ? [searchCondition] : []),
320:       ...virtualConditions,
321:     ],
322:     objectConditions: [
323:       ...filters.map(({ key, value }) => ({ [key]: value })),
324:       ...(searchObject ? [searchObject] : []),
325:       ...virtualConditions.map((condition) => ({ RAW: condition })),
326:     ],
327:   }
328: }
329: 
330: function combineObjectConditions(conditions: Record<string, unknown>[]) {
331:   if (conditions.length === 0) return undefined
332:   if (conditions.length === 1) return conditions[0]
333:   return { AND: conditions }
334: }
335: 
336: function resolveOrderColumns(
337:   ordering: ListOrdering,
338:   columns: Record<string, AnyColumn>,
339:   alias: string | undefined,
340:   primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[],
341: ) {
342:   const visibleOrder = ordering.pinnedOrder
343:     ? resolvePinnedOrder(ordering.pinnedOrder, columns, alias)
344:     : ordering.sort
345:       ? [ordering.order === 'desc' ? desc(columns[ordering.sort]) : asc(columns[ordering.sort])]
346:       : []
347:   return [...visibleOrder, ...primaryKey.map(({ key }) => asc(columns[key]))]
348: }
349: 
350: /**
351:  * Equality filters arrive as HTTP strings; coerce them to the column's type so
352:  * impossible values answer a 400 naming the key instead of a Postgres cast
353:  * error surfacing as 500.
354:  */
355: function coerceFilterValue(key: string, column: AnyColumn, raw: unknown): unknown {
356:   if (raw === null) return null
357:   const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim() : raw
358:   const kind = column.dataType as string
359:   if (kind.startsWith('boolean')) {
360:     if (value === true || value === 'true') return true
361:     if (value === false || value === 'false') return false
362:     throw validationError(`Query parameter "${key}" must be true or false.`)
363:   }
364:   if (kind.startsWith('number') || kind.startsWith('bigint')) {
365:     const parsed = Number(value)
366:     if (value === '' || Number.isNaN(parsed)) throw validationError(`Query parameter "${key}" must be a number.`)
367:     return parsed
368:   }
369:   if (kind.startsWith('string')) {
370:     // String-mode timestamps/dates still carry strings; reject values that
371:     // cannot be a date instead of letting Postgres fail the query.
372:     if (/Date|Timestamp/.test(column.columnType)) {
373:       const parsed = new Date(value as string)
374:       if (!value || Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) throw validationError(`Query parameter "${key}" must be a date.`)
375:     }
376:     return value
377:   }
378:   return value
379: }
380: 
381: function resolvePinnedOrder(pinnedOrder: NonNullable<CreateDrizzleSourceRead['pinnedOrder']>, columns: AliasSafeColumns, alias?: string) {
382:   if (typeof pinnedOrder === 'function') return pinnedOrder(columns)
383:   return alias ? pinnedOrder.map((fragment) => mapColumnsInSQLToAlias(fragment, alias)) : pinnedOrder
384: }
385: 
386: 
387: function toPositiveInteger(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
388:   const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : Number.NaN
389:   return Number.isInteger(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : fallback
390: }
391: 
392: function hasKeys(value: unknown) {
393:   return Boolean(value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) && Object.keys(value).length)
394: }
395: 
396: function splitRelationInput(input: unknown, relationByField: Map<string, DomainRelationField>) {
397:   if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) return { row: input, relations: [] as RelationWrite[] }
398: 
399:   const row: Record<string, unknown> = {}
400:   const relations: RelationWrite[] = []
401:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
402:     const relation = relationByField.get(key)
403:     if (relation) relations.push({ relation, value })
404:     else row[key] = value
405:   }
406:   return { row, relations }
407: }
408: 
409: function applyOneRelationValues(row: unknown, relations: RelationWrite[], tableColumns: Record<string, AnyColumn>) {
410:   if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) return
411:   for (const { relation, value } of relations) {
412:     if (relation.isArray) continue
413:     const sourceColumn = onlyColumn(relation.sourceColumns, relation.field)
414:     const sourceKey = getColumnKey(tableColumns, sourceColumn)
415:     if (value == null && sourceColumn.notNull) throw validationError(`Relation "${relation.field}" cannot be null because "${sourceKey}" is not nullable.`)
416:     ;(row as Record<string, unknown>)[sourceKey] = value == null ? null : getInputColumnValue(relation.targetEntity.table, onlyColumn(relation.targetColumns, relation.field), value, relation.field)
417:   }
418: }
419: 
420: async function applyManyRelationValues(
421:   database: DrizzleDb,
422:   ownerId: unknown,
423:   relations: RelationWrite[],
424:   primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[],
425:   tableColumns: Record<string, AnyColumn>,
426: ) {
427:   for (const { relation, value } of relations) {
428:     const field = relation.field
429:     if (!relation.isArray) continue
430:     if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" must be an array.`)
431: 
432:     if (relation.mode === 'through') {
433:       await applyThroughManyRelationValue(database, ownerId, relation, value, primaryKey, tableColumns)
434:       continue
435:     }
436: 
437:     const ownerColumn = onlyColumn(relation.sourceColumns, field)
438:     const childFkColumn = onlyColumn(relation.targetColumns, field)
439:     const childPk = onlyEntry(getPrimaryKeyEntries(relation.targetEntity.table), field)
440:     const ownerValue = getOwnerColumnValue(ownerId, primaryKey, getColumnKey(tableColumns, ownerColumn))
441:     const childFkKey = getColumnKey(getTableColumns(relation.targetEntity.table as never) as Record<string, AnyColumn>, childFkColumn)
442:     const selectedIds = unique(value.map((item) => getInputColumnValue(relation.targetEntity.table, childPk.column, item, field)))
443: 
444:     if (!selectedIds.length) {
445:       if (childFkColumn.notNull) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" cannot be cleared because "${childFkKey}" is not nullable.`)
446:       await database.update(relation.targetEntity.table).set({ [childFkKey]: null }).where(eq(childFkColumn, ownerValue)).returning()
447:       continue
448:     }
449: 
450:     if (childFkColumn.notNull) {
451:       const rows = await database.select().from(relation.targetEntity.table).where(eq(childFkColumn, ownerValue))
452:       const staleRows = rows.filter((row) => !selectedIds.includes((row as Record<string, unknown>)[childPk.key]))
453:       if (staleRows.length) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" cannot remove existing rows because "${childFkKey}" is not nullable.`)
454:     } else {
455:       await database
456:         .update(relation.targetEntity.table)
457:         .set({ [childFkKey]: null })
458:         .where(and(eq(childFkColumn, ownerValue), notInArray(childPk.column, selectedIds)))
459:         .returning()
460:     }
461: 
462:     await database
463:       .update(relation.targetEntity.table)
464:       .set({ [childFkKey]: ownerValue })
465:       .where(inArray(childPk.column, selectedIds))
466:       .returning()
467:   }
468: }
469: 
470: async function applyThroughManyRelationValue(
471:   database: DrizzleDb,
472:   ownerId: unknown,
473:   relation: DomainRelationField,
474:   value: unknown[],
475:   primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[],
476:   tableColumns: Record<string, AnyColumn>,
477: ) {
478:   if (!relation.throughTable || !relation.throughSourceColumns || !relation.throughTargetColumns) throw validationError(`Relation "${relation.field}" through metadata is incomplete.`)
479: 
480:   const ownerColumn = onlyColumn(relation.sourceColumns, relation.field)
481:   const targetColumn = onlyColumn(relation.targetColumns, relation.field)
482:   const throughSourceColumn = onlyColumn(relation.throughSourceColumns, relation.field)
483:   const throughTargetColumn = onlyColumn(relation.throughTargetColumns, relation.field)
484:   const throughColumns = getTableColumns(relation.throughTable as never) as Record<string, AnyColumn>
485:   const throughSourceKey = getColumnKey(throughColumns, throughSourceColumn)
486:   const throughTargetKey = getColumnKey(throughColumns, throughTargetColumn)
487:   const ownerValue = getOwnerColumnValue(ownerId, primaryKey, getColumnKey(tableColumns, ownerColumn))
488:   const selectedIds = unique(value.map((item) => getInputColumnValue(relation.targetEntity.table, targetColumn, item, relation.field)))
489: 
490:   await database.delete(relation.throughTable).where(eq(throughSourceColumn, ownerValue)).returning()
491:   if (selectedIds.length) {
492:     await database
493:       .insert(relation.throughTable)
494:       .values(selectedIds.map((selectedId) => ({ [throughSourceKey]: ownerValue, [throughTargetKey]: selectedId })))
495:       .returning()
496:   }
497: }
498: 
499: function onlyColumn(columns: AnyColumn[], field: string) {
500:   if (columns.length !== 1) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" writes only support single-column relations.`)
501:   return columns[0]
502: }
503: 
504: function onlyEntry<T>(entries: T[], field: string) {
505:   if (entries.length !== 1) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" writes only support single-column primary keys.`)
506:   return entries[0]
507: }
508: 
509: function getColumnKey(columns: Record<string, AnyColumn>, column: AnyColumn) {
510:   const entry = Object.entries(columns).find(([, candidate]) => candidate === column || candidate.name === column.name)
511:   if (!entry) throw validationError(`Column "${column.name}" not found in table metadata.`)
512:   return entry[0]
513: }
514: 
515: function getInputColumnValue(table: unknown, column: AnyColumn, input: unknown, field: string) {
516:   if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" value must be an object.`)
517:   const key = getColumnKey(getTableColumns(table as never) as Record<string, AnyColumn>, column)
518:   if (!(key in input)) throw validationError(`Relation "${field}" value must include "${key}".`)
519:   return (input as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
520: }
521: 
522: function getOwnerColumnValue(ownerId: unknown, primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[], ownerKey: string) {
523:   if (primaryKey.length === 1) return ownerId
524:   return parseCompositeId(ownerId)[ownerKey]
525: }
526: 
527: function unique(values: unknown[]) {
528:   return [...new Set(values)]
529: }
530: 
531: export function getPrimaryKeyColumns(table: unknown): AnyColumn[] {
532:   return getPrimaryKeyEntries(table).map((entry) => entry.column)
533: }
534: 
535: function parseCompositeId(id: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
536:   if (id && typeof id === 'object' && !Array.isArray(id)) return id as Record<string, unknown>
537:   if (typeof id === 'string') {
538:     const value = JSON.parse(id)
539:     if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) return value
540:   }
541:   throw new Error('Composite primary key id must be an object or JSON object string')
542: }
543: 
544: function getReturnedId(row: unknown, primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[]) {
545:   return getRowId(row, primaryKey)
546: }
547: 
548: function getRowId(row: unknown, primaryKey: { key: string; column: AnyColumn }[]) {
549:   if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return undefined
550:   if (primaryKey.length === 1) return ((row as Record<string, unknown>)[primaryKey[0].key] ?? (row as Record<string, unknown>)[primaryKey[0].column.name]) as string
551:   return Object.fromEntries(primaryKey.map(({ key, column }) => [key, (row as Record<string, unknown>)[key] ?? (row as Record<string, unknown>)[column.name]]))
552: }
```

```
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks'
import type { Context, MiddlewareHandler } from 'hono'
import type { RouteAfter } from '@southneuhof/sprindle/model'
import { z } from 'zod/v4'
import { uploadKey, storedAssetSchema, type StoredAsset } from '../schema'

export type StoredAssetMetadata = {
  size?: number
  updatedAt?: string | Date
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>
}

const requestUrlStorage = new AsyncLocalStorage<string>()

export function assetRequestContext(): MiddlewareHandler {
  return async (c: Context, next: () => Promise<void>) => {
    await requestUrlStorage.run(c.req.url, next)
  }
}

export function runWithAssetRequestUrl<T>(url: string, callback: () => T | Promise<T>) {
  return requestUrlStorage.run(url, callback)
}

function currentRequestUrl() {
  const url = requestUrlStorage.getStore()
  if (!url) throw new Error('Stored asset projection requires an active request URL.')
  return url
}

export function storedAsset(key: string, metadata: StoredAssetMetadata = {}): StoredAsset {
  const id = uploadKey.parse(key)
  const name = id.split('/').pop() || id
  const extension = name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()
  const mimeType = {
    jpg: 'image/jpeg',
    jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
    png: 'image/png',
    gif: 'image/gif',
    webp: 'image/webp',
    svg: 'image/svg+xml',
    pdf: 'application/pdf',
    txt: 'text/plain',
  }[extension ?? '']
  const url = new URL('/files/object', currentRequestUrl())
  url.searchParams.set('key', id)
  return storedAssetSchema.parse({
    kind: 'file',
    id,
    url: url.toString(),
    name,
    ...(mimeType ? { mimeType } : {}),
    ...(metadata.size === undefined ? {} : { size: metadata.size }),
    ...(metadata.updatedAt === undefined ? {} : { updatedAt: metadata.updatedAt instanceof Date ? metadata.updatedAt.toISOString() : metadata.updatedAt }),
    ...(metadata.metadata === undefined ? {} : { metadata: metadata.metadata }),
  })
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') return false
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null
}

export function projectStoredAssets(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (storedAssetSchema.safeParse(value).success) return value
  if (typeof value === 'string' && uploadKey.safeParse(value).success) return storedAsset(value)
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    const projected = value.map(projectStoredAssets)
    return projected.every((item, index) => item === value[index]) ? value : projected
  }
  if (isPlainObject(value)) {
    let changed = false
    const projected = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => {
      const next = projectStoredAssets(item)
      changed ||= next !== item
      return [key, next]
    }))
    return changed ? projected : value
  }
```
