```
import { defineFields, defineResource } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import type { FormRendererProps } from '@southneuhof/loom/renderers/formContracts'
import { menuItems } from '../menu-items/menu-items.resource'
import { ordersActions } from './orders.actions'
import { ordersSchema } from './orders.schema'

const lineFields = {
  menuItemId: {
    label: 'Item',
    form: {
      renderer: 'lookup',
      source: menuItems,
      props: { pick: 'id', view: 'name', required: true, searchParameters: { active: true } },
    },
  },
  qty: { label: 'Qty', form: { renderer: 'number', props: { min: 1, max: 99, step: 1, required: true } } },
} as const satisfies FormRendererProps<'table'>['fields']

const fields = defineFields(ordersSchema, {
  status: { label: 'Status' },
  paymentMethod: { label: 'Payment Method' },
  total: { label: 'Total (IDR)' },
  amountPaid: { label: 'Amount Paid (IDR)' },
  change: { label: 'Change (IDR)' },
  createdAt: { label: 'Created At' },
  items: {
    label: 'Items',
    form: { renderer: 'table', fields: lineFields },
  },
})

export const orders = defineResource(ordersSchema, {
  key: 'orders',
  actions: {
    list: {
      run: ordersActions.list,
      fields: [fields.status, fields.total, fields.paymentMethod, fields.createdAt],
      permission: 'view-orders',
      route: { name: 'pos-orders' },
    },
    detail: {
      run: ordersActions.detail,
      fields: [fields.status, fields.total, fields.paymentMethod, fields.amountPaid, fields.change, fields.createdAt],
      permission: 'view-orders',
      route: { name: 'pos-orders-detail', params: (id) => ({ orderId: String(id) }) },
      title: 'Order Detail',
    },
    create: {
      run: ordersActions.create,
      fields: [fields.items],
      permission: 'create-orders',
      route: { name: 'pos-orders-create' },
    },
    pay: {
      run: ordersActions.pay,
      permission: 'pay-orders',
    },
    cancel: {
      run: ordersActions.cancel,
```

```
export interface DeleteResourceActionProps<TIdentity extends RecordIdentity> {

type StandardActionNames = 'list' | 'detail' | 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'
type CustomActionKey<TActions> = Exclude<Extract<keyof TActions, string>, StandardActionNames>

/**
 * Optional trailing row context for a custom action call. The context travels
 * alongside the declared run args and is never forwarded to `run`, permission
 * resolvers, or the access adapter. A trailing `{ record }` object is reserved
 * for this purpose: an action whose own last parameter is shaped like the
 * context cannot also take a row.
 *
 * Call shapes for an order workflow with `pay(id, input)` and `cancel(id)`:
 * `pay.can(orderId, { paidAmount })` checks permission only, while
 * `pay.can(orderId, { paidAmount }, { record: row })` additionally requires
 * the row array to contain the action name. `cancel.can(orderId)` checks
 * permission only, while `cancel.can(orderId, { record: row })` adds the row
 * check. `run` enforces the same check as `can` before invoking the callback.
 */
export interface CustomActionContext<TRecord extends object = Record<string, unknown>> {
  /** Row record whose `allowedOperations` array must contain the action name. */
  record?: TRecord
}

/** Client contract for one declared custom action: check, then guarded run. */
export type CustomActionHandle<TRun extends (...args: never[]) => unknown> = {
  can: (...args: [...Parameters<TRun>, context?: CustomActionContext]) => boolean
  run: (...args: [...Parameters<TRun>, context?: CustomActionContext]) => ReturnType<TRun>
}

type CustomActions<TActions> = {
  [TKey in CustomActionKey<TActions>]: TActions[TKey] extends { run: infer TRun }
    ? TRun extends (...args: never[]) => unknown
      ? CustomActionHandle<TRun>
      : never
    : never
}

type ActionDefinition<TActions, TKey extends PropertyKey> = TActions extends Record<TKey, infer TValue> ? TValue : never
type HasAction<TActions, TKey extends StandardActionNames> = TActions extends Record<TKey, { run: (...args: never[]) => unknown }> ? true : false
```

```
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Form, ListView, Table } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { Button } from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base'
import { errorMessage } from '@/framework/adapters/data/normalize'
import { menuItems } from '../menu-items/menu-items.resource'
import { orders } from '../orders/orders.resource'
import { payForm } from '../orders/pay-form.resource'

const router = useRouter()
const cart = ref<{ menuItemId: string; qty: number }[]>([])
const paymentMethod = ref<'cash' | 'transfer' | 'qris'>('cash')
const amountPaid = ref<number | null>(null)
const submitError = ref<string | null>(null)
const paidMessage = ref<string | null>(null)
const submitting = ref(false)

const menuList = menuItems.list()

const menuNames = ref(new Map<string, string>())
const menuPrices = ref(new Map<string, number>())
const cartFields = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
  { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
  { key: 'lineTotal', label: 'Line Total (IDR)' },
] as const
const cartLines = computed(() =>
  cart.value.map((line) => {
    const price = menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0
    return {
      name: menuNames.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? line.menuItemId,
      qty: line.qty,
      lineTotal: price * line.qty,
    }
  })
)
const cartTotal = computed(() => cart.value.reduce((sum, line) => sum + (menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0) * line.qty, 0))
const changePreview = computed(() => (amountPaid.value === null ? null : amountPaid.value - cartTotal.value))

const paymentOptions = [
  { id: 'cash', name: 'Cash' },
  { id: 'transfer', name: 'Transfer' },
  { id: 'qris', name: 'QRIS' },
]

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()
const sellFields = payFormCreate.fields
const payFormSchema = payFormCreate.schema!

function addToCart(menuItemId: string, name: string, price: number) {
  menuNames.value.set(menuItemId, name)
  menuPrices.value.set(menuItemId, price)
  const line = cart.value.find((entry) => entry.menuItemId === menuItemId)
  if (line) {
    if (line.qty < 99) line.qty += 1
  } else {
    cart.value.push({ menuItemId, qty: 1 })
  }
}

async function submitSale() {
  submitError.value = null
  paidMessage.value = null
  if (!cart.value.length) {
    submitError.value = 'Add at least one item.'
    return
  }
  if (paymentMethod.value === null || amountPaid.value === null) {
    submitError.value = 'Enter payment method and amount paid.'
    return
  }
  submitting.value = true
  try {
    const created = await orders.create().run({ items: cart.value })
    const createdId = (created as { id: string }).id
    try {
      const paid = await orders.actions.pay.run(createdId, {
        paymentMethod: paymentMethod.value,
        amountPaid: amountPaid.value,
      })
      paidMessage.value = `Order paid. Change IDR ${paid.change}.`
      cart.value = []
      amountPaid.value = null
    } catch (payError) {
      submitError.value = `${errorMessage(payError, 'Payment failed.')} Order ${createdId} stays open in Orders.`
    }
  } catch (createError) {
    submitError.value = errorMessage(createError, 'Order creation failed.')
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false
  }
}

function goToOrders() {
  void router.push({ name: 'pos-orders' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    <ListView v-bind="menuList" title="Sell">
      <template #collection="{ records }">
        <ul class="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" aria-label="Available menu">
          <li v-for="item in records" :key="String((item as { id: string }).id)" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
              <span class="truncate font-medium">{{ (item as { name: string }).name }}</span>
              <span class="text-sm">IDR {{ (item as { price: number }).price }}</span>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              @click="
                () => {
                  const record = item as { id: string; name: string; price: number }
                  addToCart(String(record.id), String(record.name), Number(record.price))
                }
              "
              >Add</Button
            >
          </li>
        </ul>
      </template>
    </ListView>
    <section aria-label="Cart" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h2>Cart</h2>
      <Table :fields="cartFields" :data="cartLines" />
      <p>Total IDR {{ cartTotal }}</p>
      <p v-if="changePreview !== null">Change IDR {{ changePreview }}</p>
    </section>
    <section aria-label="Payment" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h2>Payment</h2>
      <Form :fields="sellFields" :schema="payFormSchema" :submit="submitSale" submit-label="Charge" />
      <Button type="button" variant="outlined" :disabled="submitting" @click="goToOrders">View Orders</Button>
    </section>
    <p v-if="paidMessage" role="status">{{ paidMessage }}</p>
    <p v-if="submitError" role="alert">{{ submitError }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
===========DETAIL===========
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { DetailView, DialogForm } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { Button } from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base'
import { errorMessage } from '@/framework/adapters/data/normalize'
import { orders } from '../orders.resource'
import { payForm } from '../pay-form.resource'

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()
const payFields = payFormCreate.fields
const payFormSchema = payFormCreate.schema!

const route = useRoute('pos-orders-detail')
const router = useRouter()
const orderId = route.params.orderId
const payFailed = ref<string | null>(null)
const cancelFailed = ref<string | null>(null)
const paidResult = ref<string | null>(null)

const detail = orders.detail({ id: orderId })

async function submitPay(input: { paymentMethod: string; amountPaid: number }) {
  payFailed.value = null
  paidResult.value = null
  try {
    const paid = await orders.actions.pay.run(orderId, input)
    paidResult.value = `Order paid. Change IDR ${paid.change}.`
    await orders.invalidate({ id: orderId })
  } catch (error) {
    payFailed.value = errorMessage(error, 'Payment failed.')
    throw error
  }
}

async function submitCancel() {
  cancelFailed.value = null
  try {
    await orders.actions.cancel.run(orderId)
    await router.push({ name: 'pos-orders' })
  } catch (error) {
    cancelFailed.value = errorMessage(error, 'Cancel failed.')
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    <DetailView v-bind="detail" />
    <section aria-label="Order actions" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <DialogForm :key="`pay-${orderId}`" title="Pay Order" submit-label="Pay" :schema="payFormSchema" :fields="payFields" :submit="submitPay">
        <template #trigger>
          <Button>Pay</Button>
        </template>
      </DialogForm>
      <Button variant="outlined" @click="submitCancel">Cancel Order</Button>
    </section>
    <p v-if="paidResult" role="status">{{ paidResult }}</p>
    <p v-if="payFailed" role="alert">{{ payFailed }}</p>
    <p v-if="cancelFailed" role="alert">{{ cancelFailed }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

```
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Form, ListView, Table } from '@southneuhof/loom'

const router = useRouter()

const amountPaid = ref<number | null>(null)
const submitError = ref<string | null>(null)
const paidMessage = ref<string | null>(null)
const submitting = ref(false)

const menuList = menuItems.list()

const menuNames = ref(new Map<string, string>())
const menuPrices = ref(new Map<string, number>())
const cartFields = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
  { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
  { key: 'lineTotal', label: 'Line Total (IDR)' },
] as const
const cartLines = computed(() =>
  cart.value.map((line) => {
    const price = menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0
    return {
      name: menuNames.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? line.menuItemId,
      qty: line.qty,
      lineTotal: price * line.qty,
    }
  })
)
const cartTotal = computed(() => cart.value.reduce((sum, line) => sum + (menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0) * line.qty, 0))
const changePreview = computed(() => (amountPaid.value === null ? null : amountPaid.value - cartTotal.value))

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()
const sellFields = payFormCreate.fields
const payFormSchema = payFormCreate.schema!

function addToCart(menuItemId: string, name: string, price: number) {
  menuNames.value.set(menuItemId, name)
  menuPrices.value.set(menuItemId, price)
  const line = cart.value.find((entry) => entry.menuItemId === menuItemId)
  if (line) {
    if (line.qty < 99) line.qty += 1
  } else {
    cart.value.push({ menuItemId, qty: 1 })
  }
}

async function submitSale() {
  submitError.value = null
  paidMessage.value = null
  if (!cart.value.length) {
    submitError.value = 'Add at least one item.'
```

```
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref, toValue, watch, type MaybeRefOrGetter } from 'vue'

type ColumnSizes = Record<string, number>

function canStore() {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.localStorage !== 'undefined'
}

function read<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
  if (!canStore()) return fallback
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(key) ?? 'null')
    return value == null ? fallback : value as T
  } catch {
    return fallback
  }
}

/** Namespace-scoped, SSR-safe column preferences. */
export function useTablePreferences(namespace: MaybeRefOrGetter<string | undefined>, fieldKeys: MaybeRefOrGetter<readonly string[]>, minWidth: MaybeRefOrGetter<number>) {
  const sizes = ref<ColumnSizes>({})
  const visibleKeys = ref<string[]>([])
  let visiblePersistTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  const storageKey = (name: string) => {
    const scope = toValue(namespace)
    return scope ? `is-framework:${scope}:table:${name}` : undefined
  }
  const normalize = () => {
    const keys = [...toValue(fieldKeys)]
    const minimum = toValue(minWidth)
    const sizeKey = storageKey('column-sizes')
    const visibleKey = storageKey('visible-columns')
    const storedSizes = sizeKey ? read<unknown>(sizeKey, {}) : {}
    sizes.value = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(storedSizes as Record<string, unknown>)
      .filter(([key, value]) => keys.includes(key) && typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= minimum)
      .map(([key, value]) => [key, value as number])) as ColumnSizes
    const storedVisible = visibleKey ? read<unknown>(visibleKey, keys) : keys
    if (Array.isArray(storedVisible)) visibleKeys.value = keys.filter((key) => storedVisible.includes(key))
    else if (storedVisible && typeof storedVisible === 'object' && Array.isArray((storedVisible as { visible?: unknown }).visible) && Array.isArray((storedVisible as { known?: unknown }).known)) {
      const { visible, known } = storedVisible as { visible: string[]; known: string[] }
      visibleKeys.value = keys.filter((key) => !known.includes(key) || visible.includes(key))
    } else visibleKeys.value = keys
  }
  const persistSizes = () => {
    const key = storageKey('column-sizes')
    if (!key || !canStore()) return
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(sizes.value))
  }
  const persistVisible = () => {
    const key = storageKey('visible-columns')
    if (!key || !canStore()) return
    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ known: [...toValue(fieldKeys)], visible: visibleKeys.value }))
  }
  const cancelVisiblePersist = () => {
    if (visiblePersistTimer === undefined) return
    clearTimeout(visiblePersistTimer)
    visiblePersistTimer = undefined
  }
  const scheduleVisiblePersist = () => {
    cancelVisiblePersist()
    if (!storageKey('visible-columns') || !canStore()) return
    visiblePersistTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      visiblePersistTimer = undefined
      persistVisible()
    }, 200)
  }
  function setVisible(next: readonly string[]) {
    visibleKeys.value = [...toValue(fieldKeys)].filter((key) => next.includes(key))
    scheduleVisiblePersist()
  }
  function setSizes(next: ColumnSizes) {
    sizes.value = next
    persistSizes()
  }
  function resetColumns() {
    cancelVisiblePersist()
    const sizeKey = storageKey('column-sizes')
    const visibleKey = storageKey('visible-columns')
    if (canStore()) {
      if (sizeKey) window.localStorage.removeItem(sizeKey)
      if (visibleKey) window.localStorage.removeItem(visibleKey)
    }
    sizes.value = {}
    visibleKeys.value = [...toValue(fieldKeys)]
  }
  onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    if (visiblePersistTimer === undefined) return
    cancelVisiblePersist()
    persistVisible()
  })
  watch([() => toValue(namespace), () => [...toValue(fieldKeys)].join('|'), () => toValue(minWidth)], normalize, { immediate: true })
  return { sizes, visibleKeys, setSizes, setVisible, resetColumns }
}
```

```
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { DetailView, DialogForm } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { Button } from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base'
import { errorMessage } from '@/framework/adapters/data/normalize'
import { orders } from '../orders.resource'
import { payForm } from '../pay-form.resource'

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()
const payFields = payFormCreate.fields
const payFormSchema = payFormCreate.schema!

const route = useRoute('pos-orders-detail')
const router = useRouter()
const orderId = route.params.orderId
const payFailed = ref<string | null>(null)
const cancelFailed = ref<string | null>(null)
const paidResult = ref<string | null>(null)

const detail = orders.detail({ id: orderId })

async function submitPay(input: { paymentMethod: string; amountPaid: number }) {
  payFailed.value = null
  paidResult.value = null
  try {
    const paid = await orders.actions.pay.run(orderId, input)
    paidResult.value = `Order paid. Change IDR ${paid.change}.`
    await orders.invalidate({ id: orderId })
  } catch (error) {
    payFailed.value = errorMessage(error, 'Payment failed.')
    throw error
  }
}

async function submitCancel() {
  cancelFailed.value = null
  try {
    await orders.actions.cancel.run(orderId)
    await router.push({ name: 'pos-orders' })
  } catch (error) {
    cancelFailed.value = errorMessage(error, 'Cancel failed.')
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    <DetailView v-bind="detail" />
    <section aria-label="Order actions" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <DialogForm :key="`pay-${orderId}`" title="Pay Order" submit-label="Pay" :schema="payFormSchema" :fields="payFields" :submit="submitPay">
        <template #trigger>
          <Button>Pay</Button>
        </template>
      </DialogForm>
      <Button variant="outlined" @click="submitCancel">Cancel Order</Button>
    </section>
    <p v-if="paidResult" role="status">{{ paidResult }}</p>
    <p v-if="payFailed" role="alert">{{ payFailed }}</p>
    <p v-if="cancelFailed" role="alert">{{ cancelFailed }}</p>
  </div>
</template>
```

```
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick } from 'vue'

import { Form, FrameworkPlugin, createFrameworkQueryClient } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { appInputProps } from '@/framework/inputs/registry'

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()

const paymentOptions = [
  { id: 'cash', name: 'Cash' },
  { id: 'transfer', name: 'Transfer' },
  { id: 'qris', name: 'QRIS' },
]

async function flush(times = 10) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < times; attempt += 1) {
    await Promise.resolve()
    await nextTick()
  }
}

function mountPayForm(submit: (value: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>) {
  const host = document.createElement('div')
  document.body.appendChild(host)
  const router = createRouter({
    history: createMemoryHistory(),
    routes: [{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', name: 'test-route', component: { render: () => null } }],
  })
  const app = createApp(
    defineComponent({
      setup() {
        return () =>
          // @ts-expect-error jsdom test host passes Form props through h(); vue-tsc strict slots typing is covered by Loom type-check
          h(Form, {
            fields: sellFields,
            schema: payFormSchema,
            submit,
          })
      },
    })
  )
  app.use(router)
  app.use(FrameworkPlugin, { inputProps: appInputProps, queryClient: createFrameworkQueryClient({ retry: 0, staleTime: 0 }) })
  app.mount(host)
  return { host, app }
}

describe('sell payment form', () => {
  it('renders payment labels and select options', async () => {
    const { host, app } = mountPayForm(async () => undefined)
    await flush()
    await flush()
    const text = host.textContent ?? ''
    expect(text).toContain('Payment Method')
    expect(text).toContain('Amount Paid (IDR)')
    const trigger = host.querySelector('[aria-label="Open navigation"], [role="combobox"], button') as HTMLElement | null
    expect(trigger).not.toBeNull()
    const buttons = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll('button')).map((entry) => entry.textContent ?? '')
    expect(buttons.some((entry) => entry.includes('Submit'))).toBe(true)
    expect(paymentOptions).toHaveLength(3)
    expect(paymentOptions.map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual(['cash', 'transfer', 'qris'])
    app.unmount()
    host.remove()

  it('rejects empty payment and accepts cash exact pay', async () => {
    expect(payFormSchema.validate({})).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ success: false }))
    expect(payFormSchema.validate({ paymentMethod: 'cash', amountPaid: 25000 })).toEqual({
      success: true,
      data: { paymentMethod: 'cash', amountPaid: 25000 },
    })
  })
})
```

```
import { beginPageReadiness, FrameworkPlugin, markPageNavigationSettled, setPageReadinessError } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { FileManagerPlugin } from '@southneuhof/loom/file-manager'
import { createFrameworkAdapters } from './framework/adapters/bundle'
import { fileManagerOptions } from './framework/adapters/fileManager'
import { appFieldRenderers } from './framework/fields/renderers'
import { appFieldDefaults } from '@/configs/defaults'

import { dictionary } from '@/configs/dictionary'
import App from './App.vue'
import router from './router'

import '@southneuhof/loom/styles/state-layers.css'
import 'vue-sonner/style.css'
import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css'
import VueTippy from 'vue-tippy'
import 'tippy.js/dist/tippy.css' // optional for styling

const app = createApp(App)
beginPageReadiness()
router.beforeEach(() => beginPageReadiness())
router.afterEach(() => markPageNavigationSettled())
router.onError((error) => setPageReadinessError(error))
configureParser({ dictionary })
declare module 'vue' {
  export interface ComponentCustomProperties {
    $parse: (key: string, value: string | number, mode?: 'dictionary' | 'parser') => any
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
  app.use(createPinia())
  app.use(FrameworkPlugin, {
    adapters: createFrameworkAdapters(router),
    fieldDefaults: appFieldDefaults,
    renderers: appFieldRenderers,
    inputProps: appInputProps,
    uiDefaults: { backLabel: 'Kembali' },
  })
  app.use(FileManagerPlugin, fileManagerOptions)
  app.use(router)
  app.use(
    VueTippy,
    // optional
    {
      directive: 'tippy', // => v-tippy
      component: 'tippy', // => <tippy/>
      componentSingleton: 'tippy-singleton', // => <tippy-singleton/>,
      defaultProps: {
        placement: 'top',
        allowHTML: true,
      }, // => Global default options * see all props
    }
  )
  app.config.globalProperties.$parse = parse

  app.config.errorHandler = (err, vm, info) => {
    console.error('Global error handler :: ', err)
    // Handle the error (e.g., log it, show a notification, etc.)
  }

  await router.isReady()
  app.mount('#app')
})
```

```
import { defineComponent, h, type PropType } from 'vue'
import type { RendererRegistriesInput } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import Chip from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base/Chip.vue'
import ImagePreview from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base/ImagePreview.vue'
import { assetAdapter } from '../adapters/assets'

interface ChipOption {
  color?: string
  label?: string
}

const chipRenderer = defineComponent({
  name: 'AppFieldChipRenderer',
  props: {
    value: { type: null, default: undefined },
    options: {
      type: Object as PropType<Record<string, ChipOption>>,
      default: () => ({}),
    },
  },
  setup(props) {
    return () => {
      const option = props.options[String(props.value)]
      return h(Chip, { color: option?.color as never }, () => option?.label ?? String(props.value ?? '-'))
    }
  },
})

const textBlockRenderer = defineComponent({
  name: 'AppFieldTextBlockRenderer',
  props: { value: { type: null, default: undefined } },
  setup: (props) => () => h('div', { class: 'whitespace-pre-wrap' }, String(props.value ?? '-')),
})

const imageRenderer = defineComponent({
  name: 'AppFieldImageRenderer',
  props: { value: { type: null, default: undefined } },
  setup(props) {
    return () => {
      const value = assetAdapter.read(props.value)
      const assets = Array.isArray(value) ? value : value ? [value] : []
      const images = assets.flatMap((asset) => {
        const preview = assetAdapter.preview(asset)
        return preview.imageURL ? [{ ...preview, id: asset.id }] : []
      })

      if (!images.length) return h('span', '-')
      return h(
        'div',
        { class: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2' },
        images.map((image) =>
          h(ImagePreview, {
            key: image.id,
            imageURL: image.imageURL,
            thumbnailURL: image.thumbnailURL,
            disableControls: true,
          })
        )
      )
    }
```

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick, ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Form, Table, FrameworkPlugin, createFrameworkQueryClient } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { appInputProps } from '@/framework/inputs/registry'
import { payForm } from '@/routes/(authenticated)/pos/orders/pay-form.resource'

async function flush(times = 12) {
  for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) { await Promise.resolve(); await nextTick() }
}

function mountWith(node: unknown) {
  const host = document.createElement('div')
  document.body.appendChild(host)
  const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [{ path: '/:p(.*)*', name: 'r', component: { render: () => null } }] })
  const app = createApp(defineComponent({ setup: () => () => node }))
  app.use(router)
  app.use(FrameworkPlugin, { inputProps: appInputProps, queryClient: createFrameworkQueryClient({ retry: 0, staleTime: 0 }) })
  app.mount(host)
  return { host, app }
}

describe('debug sell', () => {
  it('dumps form html and select trigger', async () => {
    const bag = payForm.create()
    const { host, app } = mountWith(
      // @ts-expect-error harness
      h(Form, { fields: bag.fields, schema: bag.schema, submit: async () => undefined }),
    )
    await flush()
    await flush()
    console.log('FORM HTML:', host.innerHTML.slice(0, 3000))
    app.unmount(); host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })

  it('dumps table empty vs one row', async () => {
    const cartFields = [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
      { key: 'lineTotal', label: 'Line Total (IDR)' },
    ]
    const mk = (rows: unknown[]) => mountWith(h(Table, { fields: cartFields, data: rows }))
    const e = mk([])
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('TABLE EMPTY:', e.host.innerHTML.slice(0, 1500))
    e.app.unmount(); e.host.remove()
    const f = mk([{ name: 'Latte', qty: 1, lineTotal: 25000 }])
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('TABLE ONEROW:', f.host.innerHTML.slice(0, 3000))
    f.app.unmount(); f.host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick, ref } from 'vue'
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Form, Table, FrameworkPlugin, createFrameworkQueryClient } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { appInputProps } from '@/framework/inputs/registry'
import { payForm } from '@/routes/(authenticated)/pos/orders/pay-form.resource'

async function flush(times = 15) {
  for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) { await Promise.resolve(); await nextTick() }
}

function mountNode(node: unknown) {
  const host = document.createElement('div')
  document.body.appendChild(host)
  const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [{ path: '/:p(.*)*', name: 'r', component: { render: () => null } }] })
  const app = createApp(defineComponent({ setup: () => () => node }))
  app.use(router)
  app.use(FrameworkPlugin, { inputProps: appInputProps, queryClient: createFrameworkQueryClient({ retry: 0, staleTime: 0 }) })
  app.mount(host)
  return { host, app }
}

describe('debug sell live', () => {
  it('opens the payment select and shows options', async () => {
    const bag = payForm.create()
    const { host, app } = mountNode(
      // @ts-expect-error harness
      h(Form, { fields: bag.fields, schema: bag.schema, submit: async () => undefined }),
    )
    await flush()
    await flush()
    const trigger = host.querySelector('[id^="reka-popover-trigger"]') as HTMLElement | null
    console.log('TRIGGER:', trigger ? trigger.outerHTML.slice(0, 200) : 'NONE')
    expect(trigger).not.toBeNull()
    trigger!.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }))
    await flush()
    await flush()
    console.log('BODY AFTER CLICK:', document.body.innerHTML.slice(-2000))
    app.unmount(); host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })

  it('cart table reacts from empty to one row', async () => {
    const cart = ref<{ menuItemId: string; qty: number }[]>([])
    const names = new Map([['a', 'Latte']])
    const prices = new Map([['a', 25000]])
    const cartFields = [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
      { key: 'lineTotal', label: 'Line Total (IDR)' },
    ]
    const { host, app } = mountNode(
      h(Table, {
        fields: cartFields,
        data: cart.value.map((line) => ({ name: names.get(line.menuItemId), qty: line.qty, lineTotal: (prices.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0) * line.qty })),
      }),
    )
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('CART EMPTY:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    cart.value.push({ menuItemId: 'a', qty: 1 })
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('CART ONEROW:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    app.unmount(); host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })
})

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { createApp, defineComponent, h, nextTick, ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { createMemoryHistory, createRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Table, FrameworkPlugin, createFrameworkQueryClient } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { appInputProps } from '@/framework/inputs/registry'

async function flush(times = 15) {
  for (let i = 0; i < times; i++) { await Promise.resolve(); await nextTick() }
}

function mountNode(setup: () => unknown) {
  const host = document.createElement('div')
  document.body.appendChild(host)
  const router = createRouter({ history: createMemoryHistory(), routes: [{ path: '/:p(.*)*', name: 'r', component: { render: () => null } }] })
  const app = createApp(defineComponent({ setup: () => setup as never }))
  app.use(router)
  app.use(FrameworkPlugin, { inputProps: appInputProps, queryClient: createFrameworkQueryClient({ retry: 0, staleTime: 0 }) })
  app.mount(host)
  return { host, app }
}

describe('debug cart binding', () => {
  it('static array prop does not react', async () => {
    const cartFields = [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
    ]
    const Holder = defineComponent({
      setup() {
        const cart = ref<{ menuItemId: string; qty: number }[]>([])
        const rows = computed(() => cart.value.map((l) => ({ name: l.menuItemId, qty: l.qty })))
        // BUG MIRROR: snapshot the array once, like `:data="cartLines"` where cartLines is not reactive
        const snapshot = rows.value
        const add = () => cart.value.push({ menuItemId: 'a', qty: 1 })
        return () => h('div', [
          h(Table, { fields: cartFields, data: snapshot }),
          h('button', { onClick: add }, 'add'),
        ])
      },
    })
    const { host, app } = mountNode(() => h(Holder))
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('STATIC EMPTY:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    ;(host.querySelector('button') as HTMLElement).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }))
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('STATIC AFTER ADD:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    app.unmount(); host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })

  it('computed ref prop reacts', async () => {
    const cartFields = [
      { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
      { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
    ]
    const Holder = defineComponent({
      setup() {
        const cart = ref<{ menuItemId: string; qty: number }[]>([])
        const rows = computed(() => cart.value.map((l) => ({ name: l.menuItemId, qty: l.qty })))
        const add = () => cart.value.push({ menuItemId: 'a', qty: 1 })
        return () => h('div', [
          h(Table, { fields: cartFields, data: rows.value }),
          h('button', { onClick: add }, 'add'),
        ])
      },
    })
    const { host, app } = mountNode(() => h(Holder))
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('COMPUTED EMPTY:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    ;(host.querySelector('button') as HTMLElement).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }))
    await flush(); await flush()
    console.log('COMPUTED AFTER ADD:', JSON.stringify(host.textContent))
    app.unmount(); host.remove()
    expect(true).toBe(true)
  })
})

```
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { Form, ListView, Table } from '@southneuhof/loom'
import { Button } from '@southneuhof/loom/components/base'
import { errorMessage } from '@/framework/adapters/data/normalize'
import { menuItems } from '../menu-items/menu-items.resource'
import { orders } from '../orders/orders.resource'
import { payForm } from '../orders/pay-form.resource'

const router = useRouter()
const cart = ref<{ menuItemId: string; qty: number }[]>([])
const submitError = ref<string | null>(null)
const paidMessage = ref<string | null>(null)
const submitting = ref(false)

const menuList = menuItems.list()

const menuNames = ref(new Map<string, string>())
const menuPrices = ref(new Map<string, number>())
const cartFields = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Item' },
  { key: 'qty', label: 'Qty' },
  { key: 'lineTotal', label: 'Line Total (IDR)' },
] as const
const cartLines = computed(() =>
  cart.value.map((line) => {
    const price = menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0
    return {
      name: menuNames.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? line.menuItemId,
      qty: line.qty,
      lineTotal: price * line.qty,
    }
  })
)
const cartTotal = computed(() => cart.value.reduce((sum, line) => sum + (menuPrices.value.get(line.menuItemId) ?? 0) * line.qty, 0))

const payFormCreate = payForm.create()
const sellFields = payFormCreate.fields
const payFormSchema = payFormCreate.schema!

function addToCart(menuItemId: string, name: string, price: number) {
  menuNames.value.set(menuItemId, name)
  menuPrices.value.set(menuItemId, price)
  const line = cart.value.find((entry) => entry.menuItemId === menuItemId)
  if (line) {
    if (line.qty < 99) line.qty += 1
  } else {
    cart.value.push({ menuItemId, qty: 1 })
  }
}

async function submitSale(input: { paymentMethod: 'cash' | 'transfer' | 'qris'; amountPaid: number }) {
  submitError.value = null
  paidMessage.value = null
  if (!cart.value.length) {
    submitError.value = 'Add at least one item.'
    return
  }
  submitting.value = true
  try {
    const created = await orders.create().run({ items: cart.value })
    const createdId = (created as { id: string }).id
    try {
      const paid = await orders.actions.pay.run(createdId, {
        paymentMethod: input.paymentMethod,
        amountPaid: input.amountPaid,
      })
      paidMessage.value = `Order paid. Change IDR ${paid.change}.`
      cart.value = []
    } catch (payError) {
      submitError.value = `${errorMessage(payError, 'Payment failed.')} Order ${createdId} stays open in Orders.`
    }
  } catch (createError) {
    submitError.value = errorMessage(createError, 'Order creation failed.')
  } finally {
    submitting.value = false
  }
}

function goToOrders() {
  void router.push({ name: 'pos-orders' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    <ListView v-bind="menuList" title="Sell">
      <template #collection="{ records }">
        <ul class="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" aria-label="Available menu">
          <li v-for="item in records" :key="String((item as { id: string }).id)" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
              <span class="truncate font-medium">{{ (item as { name: string }).name }}</span>
              <span class="text-sm">IDR {{ (item as { price: number }).price }}</span>
            </div>
            <Button
              type="button"
              @click="
                () => {
                  const record = item as { id: string; name: string; price: number }
                  addToCart(String(record.id), String(record.name), Number(record.price))
                }
              "
              >Add</Button
            >
          </li>
        </ul>
      </template>
    </ListView>
    <section aria-label="Cart" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h2>Cart</h2>
      <Table :fields="cartFields" :data="cartLines" />
      <p>Total IDR {{ cartTotal }}</p>
    </section>
    <section aria-label="Payment" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h2>Payment</h2>
      <Form :fields="sellFields" :schema="payFormSchema" :submit="submitSale" submit-label="Charge" />
      <Button type="button" variant="outlined" :disabled="submitting" @click="goToOrders">View Orders</Button>
    </section>
    <p v-if="paidMessage" role="status">{{ paidMessage }}</p>
    <p v-if="submitError" role="alert">{{ submitError }}</p>
  </div>
</template>

```

}

Design gap resolved 2026-09-20: cart rows now show item names and line totals from a local name/price cache; authoritative snapshot still comes from the created order. Fixed all three. Please reload `pos/sell` — the select opens with Cash/Transfer/QRIS, labels render, and the cart table flips from "No data" to rows on Add.

What changed:
- New `pos/orders/pay-form.resource.ts`: pay fields live in a real resource catalog (static options as field `source`, proper labels), consumed via `payForm.create()` bags on both the sell page and the order detail dialog. This one change fixes issues 1 and 2 together.
- Sell page cart: explicit `cartFields` (Item/Qty/Line Total) + `cartLines` computed rows, with `addToCart` caching names and prices.
- Bonus fix found during diagnosis: `submitSale` ignored the Form draft and read dead local refs (`paymentMethod`/`amountPaid` were initialized but never bound to any input), so charging would always have used defaults. It now consumes the Form's validated `input`, and the dead change preview is removed.

Verification: web 47 files / 236 pass, type-check clean, focused lint clean, plus throwaway jsdom reproductions (removed after) proving the dropdown opens with all three options and the table transitions from "No data" to a populated row. The dev servers from the earlier session are still running if you want to check live.

Detailed report:

**1. Select shows no options — cause.** Two stacked defects. The options array was passed as `props.data`, but `SelectInput` has no `data` prop — it reads options exclusively through `useOptionSource(props)`, which resolves `data`/`load` from the field-level `source` via the app `inputProps` registry (`select: options` normalizer returns `{ data: source }` for static arrays). `props.data` is just spread onto the DOM and ignored. On top of that, even a correctly placed `source` would never have arrived: the fields were raw `defineFields()` references handed straight to `<Form :fields>`, but `Form`/`resolveFields` treats each entry as a plain catalog definition — only the resource layer's `resolveFieldReferences()` unwraps the symbol-keyed `{ schema, key, definition }` payload. So `source`, `label`, and everything else inside the reference casing was silently dropped. My jsdom dump confirmed it: the rendered select element carried `data="[object Object]..."` and `options="cash,transfer,qris"` as inert DOM attributes with an empty dropdown.

**2. Labels wrong — cause.** Same root cause as above, different symptom. `resolveFields` merges `definition.label`, but the definition it saw was the reference shell `{ key, override, Symbol }`, not the inner `{ label, form }`. With `label` undefined it falls back to the key, hence raw `paymentMethod` / `amountPaid` text. Passing the resource action bag (`payForm.create().fields`, resolved through `resolveFieldReferences` → plain `{ key, ...definition }`) restores the labels — confirmed in the same reproduction run.

**3. Table disappears on Add — cause.** The cart used `<Table :fields="[]" :data="cartLines" />`. Core `Table` builds its columns exclusively from `fields` (`TableContent` → `visibleFields` → `columns`); `empty` only covers the zero-rows case. With zero fields, the empty state ("No data") renders fine, but the moment a row arrives it renders a table with headers for zero columns and cells for zero columns — an empty bordered shell that reads as "the table completely disappeared." This one is easy to misread as a reactivity bug; I proved it isn't by isolating `Table` with static vs. reactive data (reactive works fine). The fix is explicit columns plus shaped rows.

**Was this my mistake? Yes, all three, with a shared reasoning failure.** I composed the sell page from three different API shapes without checking any of them against source: I guessed `props.data` for options by analogy with generic UI libraries instead of reading `SelectInput`/`useOptionSource`; I assumed `defineFields()` output was directly consumable by `Form` because resource files make it *look* that way (they pass references into `defineResource`, which resolves them — a step I skipped); and I assumed `Table` would infer columns from row keys, because many table components do. `vue-tsc` couldn't catch any of it: the field/reference types are loose by design (`as never` casts I added myself silenced the rest), `props` is an open record, and an empty fields array is type-valid. The existing test suite couldn't catch it either — no test mounted this page, and the specs I wrote asserted schema validation rather than rendered output. The deeper pattern across both incidents: I treated Loom's resource layer as boilerplate to route around, when it is the layer that performs the unwrapping, resolution, and normalization these components depend on.
